translations.en.sahih: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مُوسَىٰ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَاهُ نَجِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
translations.en.transliteration: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَا أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ نَبِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَالزَّكَاةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And We raised him to a high station.
translations.en.transliteration: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ آدَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْرَائِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَاجْتَبَيْنَا ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩

translations.en.sahih: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan

verses.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا

translations.en.sahih: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
translations.en.transliteration: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْئًا

translations.en.sahih: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan

verses.arabic: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُ بِالْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَأْتِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
translations.en.transliteration: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَامًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
translations.en.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
translations.en.transliteration: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
translations.en.transliteration: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَاصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهِ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ أَإِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan

verses.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا

translations.en.sahih: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
translations.en.transliteration: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan

verses.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَالشَّيَاطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
translations.en.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan

verses.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
translations.en.transliteration: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّي الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّنَذَرُ الظَّالِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَيُّ الْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا

translations.en.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَاثًا وَرِئْيًا

translations.en.sahih: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
translations.en.transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِي الضَّلَالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا السَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan

verses.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى ۗ وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا

translations.en.sahih: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي كَفَرَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan

verses.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ الْغَيْبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

translations.en.sahih: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
translations.en.transliteration: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّا

translations.en.sahih: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan

verses.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا

translations.en.sahih: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan

verses.arabic: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا لَهُمْ عِزًّا

translations.en.sahih: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
translations.en.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا

translations.en.sahih: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا

translations.en.sahih: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى الرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا

translations.en.sahih: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan

verses.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا

translations.en.sahih: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
translations.en.transliteration: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا

translations.en.sahih: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
translations.en.transliteration: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْئًا إِدًّا

translations.en.sahih: You have done an atrocious thing.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad jitum shayan iddan

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ السَّمَاوَاتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ الْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّا

translations.en.sahih: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
translations.en.transliteration: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan

verses.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا

translations.en.sahih: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
translations.en.transliteration: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا آتِي الرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا

translations.en.sahih: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
translations.en.transliteration: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَاهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا

translations.en.sahih: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ آتِيهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَرْدًا

translations.en.sahih: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا

translations.en.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا

translations.en.sahih: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
translations.en.transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan

verses.arabic: طه

translations.en.sahih: Ta, Ha.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ta</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: مَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> anzaln<u>a</u> AAalayka alqur<u>a</u>na litashq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
translations.en.transliteration: Ill<u>a</u> ta<u>th</u>kiratan liman yakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ وَالسَّمَاوَاتِ الْعُلَى

translations.en.sahih: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula

verses.arabic: الرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
translations.en.transliteration: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa

verses.arabic: لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
translations.en.transliteration: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِالْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى

translations.en.sahih: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
translations.en.transliteration: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
translations.en.transliteration: All<u>a</u>hu l<u>a</u> il<u>a</u>ha ill<u>a</u> huwa lahu alasm<u>a</u>o al<u>h</u>usn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
translations.en.transliteration: Wahal at<u>a</u>ka <u>h</u>adeethu moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِذْ رَأَىٰ نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّي آتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى

translations.en.sahih: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
translations.en.transliteration: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
translations.en.transliteration: Falamm<u>a</u> at<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> noodiya y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنِّي أَنَا رَبُّكَ فَاخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَا اخْتَرْتُكَ فَاسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
translations.en.transliteration: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha

verses.arabic: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
translations.en.transliteration: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree

verses.arabic: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda

verses.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> tilka biyameenika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّأُ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَآرِبُ أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la hiya AAa<u>sa</u>ya atawakkao AAalayh<u>a</u> waahushshu bih<u>a</u> AAal<u>a</u> ghanamee waliya feeh<u>a</u> ma<u>a</u>ribu okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la alqih<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَاهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
translations.en.transliteration: Faalq<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> fai<u>tha</u> hiya <u>h</u>ayyatun tasAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la khu<u>th</u>h<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> takhaf sanuAAeeduh<u>a</u> seeratah<u>a</u> alool<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ آيَةً أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
translations.en.transliteration: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra

verses.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا الْكُبْرَى

translations.en.sahih: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
translations.en.transliteration: Linuriyaka min <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> alkubr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u>hab il<u>a</u> firAAawna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la rabbi ishra<u>h</u> lee <u>s</u>adree

verses.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

translations.en.sahih: And ease for me my task
translations.en.transliteration: Wayassir lee amree

verses.arabic: وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي

translations.en.sahih: And untie the knot from my tongue
translations.en.transliteration: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee

verses.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

translations.en.sahih: That they may understand my speech.
translations.en.transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِي

translations.en.sahih: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
translations.en.transliteration: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee

verses.arabic: هَارُونَ أَخِي

translations.en.sahih: Aaron, my brother.
translations.en.transliteration: H<u>a</u>roona akhee

verses.arabic: اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي

translations.en.sahih: Increase through him my strength
translations.en.transliteration: Oshdud bihi azree

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي

translations.en.sahih: And let him share my task
translations.en.transliteration: Waashrikhu fee amree

verses.arabic: كَيْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: That we may exalt You much
translations.en.transliteration: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran

verses.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And remember You much.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanathkuraka katheeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
translations.en.transliteration: Innaka kunta bina baseeran

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la qad ooteeta sulaka y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad manann<u>a</u> AAalayka marratan okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u> aw<u>h</u>ayn<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> ommika m<u>a</u> yoo<u>ha</u>

verses.arabic: أَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ فِي التَّابُوتِ فَاقْذِفِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّي وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِي

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
translations.en.transliteration: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِي أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَاكَ إِلَىٰ أُمِّكَ كَيْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَاكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونًا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِي أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u> tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAal<u>a</u> man yakfuluhu farajaAAn<u>a</u>ka il<u>a</u> ommika kay taqarra AAaynuh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ta<u>h</u>zana waqatalta nafsan fanajjayn<u>a</u>ka mina alghammi wafatann<u>a</u>ka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAal<u>a</u> qadarin y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي

translations.en.sahih: And I produced you for Myself.
translations.en.transliteration: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee

verses.arabic: اذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِآيَاتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكْرِي

translations.en.sahih: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u>hab anta waakhooka bi<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tee wal<u>a</u> taniy<u>a</u> fee <u>th</u>ikree

verses.arabic: اذْهَبَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> firAAawna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
translations.en.transliteration: Faqool<u>a</u> lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yata<u>th</u>akkaru aw yakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>l<u>a</u> rabban<u>a</u> innan<u>a</u> nakh<u>a</u>fu an yafru<u>t</u>a AAalayn<u>a</u> aw an ya<u>t</u>gh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَا ۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَا أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la l<u>a</u> takh<u>a</u>f<u>a</u> innanee maAAakum<u>a</u> asmaAAu waar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَاكَ بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الْهُدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda

verses.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْنَا أَنَّ الْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
translations.en.transliteration: Inn<u>a</u> qad oo<u>h</u>iya ilayn<u>a</u> anna alAAa<u>tha</u>ba AAal<u>a</u> man ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la faman rabbukum<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la rabbun<u>a</u> alla<u>th</u>ee aAA<u>ta</u> kulla shayin khalqahu thumma had<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ الْقُرُونِ الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la fam<u>a</u> b<u>a</u>lu alqurooni alool<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَابٍ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la AAilmuh<u>a</u> AAinda rabbee fee kit<u>a</u>bin l<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>illu rabbee wal<u>a</u> yans<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta

verses.arabic: كُلُوا وَارْعَوْا أَنْعَامَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

verses.arabic: مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
translations.en.transliteration: Minh<u>a</u> khalaqn<u>a</u>kum wafeeh<u>a</u> nuAAeedukum waminh<u>a</u> nukhrijukum t<u>a</u>ratan okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَاهُ آيَاتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad arayn<u>a</u>hu <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> kullah<u>a</u> faka<u>thth</u>aba waab<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la ajitan<u>a</u> litukhrijan<u>a</u> min ar<u>d</u>in<u>a</u> bisi<u>h</u>rika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِ فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلَا أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى

translations.en.sahih: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
translations.en.transliteration: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ النَّاسُ ضُحًى

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
translations.en.transliteration: Fatawall<u>a</u> firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma at<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ افْتَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la lahum moos<u>a</u> waylakum l<u>a</u> taftaroo AAal<u>a</u> All<u>a</u>hi ka<u>th</u>iban fayus<u>h</u>itakum biAAa<u>tha</u>bin waqad kh<u>a</u>ba mani iftar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَتَنَازَعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
translations.en.transliteration: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>loo in h<u>atha</u>ni las<u>ah</u>ir<u>a</u>ni yureed<u>a</u>ni an yukhrij<u>a</u>kum min ar<u>d</u>ikum bisi<u>h</u>rihim<u>a</u> waya<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> bi<u>t</u>areeqatikumu almuthl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ائْتُوا صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ الْيَوْمَ مَنِ اسْتَعْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
translations.en.transliteration: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo <u>s</u>affan waqad afla<u>h</u>a alyawma mani istaAAl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِيَ وَإِمَّا أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>loo y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u> imm<u>a</u> an tulqiya waimm<u>a</u> an nakoona awwala man alq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la bal alqoo fai<u>tha</u> <u>h</u>ib<u>a</u>luhum waAAi<u>s</u>iyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min si<u>h</u>rihim annah<u>a</u> tasAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِي نَفْسِهِ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
translations.en.transliteration: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْأَعْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
translations.en.transliteration: Quln<u>a</u> l<u>a</u> takhaf innaka anta alaAAl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوا ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا كَيْدُ سَاحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ السَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
translations.en.transliteration: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِي جُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَا أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَاءَنَا مِنَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَالَّذِي فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَاقْضِ مَا أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِي هَـٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: إِنَّا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَايَانَا وَمَا أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ السِّحْرِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama l<u>a</u> yamootu feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ya<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ الصَّالِحَاتِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجَاتُ الْعُلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula

verses.arabic: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
translations.en.transliteration: Jann<u>a</u>tu AA<u>a</u>dnin tajree min ta<u>h</u>tih<u>a</u> alanh<u>a</u>ru kh<u>a</u>lideena feeh<u>a</u> wa<u>tha</u>lika jaz<u>a</u>o man tazakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِي الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَافُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ الْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ

translations.en.sahih: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
translations.en.transliteration: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi m<u>a</u> ghashiyahum

verses.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُ وَمَا هَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
translations.en.transliteration: Waa<u>d</u>alla firAAawnu qawmahu wam<u>a</u> had<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: يَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَاكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَاعَدْنَاكُمْ جَانِبَ الطُّورِ الْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَنَّ وَالسَّلْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
translations.en.transliteration: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa

verses.arabic: كُلُوا مِن طَيِّبَاتِ مَا رَزَقْنَاكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِي ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِي فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo min <u>t</u>ayyib<u>a</u>ti m<u>a</u> razaqn<u>a</u>kum wal<u>a</u> ta<u>t</u>ghaw feehi faya<u>h</u>illa AAalaykum gha<u>d</u>abee waman ya<u>h</u>lil AAalayhi gha<u>d</u>abee faqad haw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّي لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا ثُمَّ اهْتَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnee laghaff<u>a</u>run liman t<u>a</u>ba wa<u>a</u>mana waAAamila <u>sa</u>li<u>h</u>an thumma ihtad<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> aAAjalaka AAan qawmika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُولَاءِ عَلَىٰ أَثَرِي وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la hum ol<u>a</u>i AAal<u>a</u> atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litar<u>da</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِن بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السَّامِرِيُّ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu

verses.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ غَضْبَانَ أَسِفًا ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِي

translations.en.sahih: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
translations.en.transliteration: FarajaAAa moos<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> qawmihi gha<u>d</u>b<u>a</u>na asifan q<u>a</u>la y<u>a</u> qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan <u>h</u>asanan afa<u>ta</u>la AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an ya<u>h</u>illa AAalaykum gha<u>d</u>abun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee

verses.arabic: قَالُوا مَا أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَا أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَاهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا هَـٰذَا إِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِيَ

translations.en.sahih: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
translations.en.transliteration: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا

translations.en.sahih: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
translations.en.transliteration: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَارُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاتَّبِعُونِي وَأَطِيعُوا أَمْرِي

translations.en.sahih: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>loo lan nabra<u>h</u>a AAalayhi AA<u>a</u>kifeena <u>h</u>att<u>a</u> yarjiAAa ilayn<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَا هَارُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوا

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la y<u>a</u> h<u>a</u>roonu m<u>a</u> manaAAaka i<u>th</u> raaytahum <u>d</u>alloo

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِي

translations.en.sahih: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
translations.en.transliteration: All<u>a</u> tattabiAAani afaAAa<u>s</u>ayta amree

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَا ابْنَ أُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِي وَلَا بِرَأْسِي ۖ إِنِّي خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِي

translations.en.sahih: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la ya bna omma l<u>a</u> takhu<u>th</u> bili<u>h</u>yatee wal<u>a</u> birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee isr<u>a</u>eela walam tarqub qawlee

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَا سَامِرِيُّ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا بِهِ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ الرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِي نَفْسِي

translations.en.sahih: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ إِلَـٰهِكَ الَّذِي ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُ فِي الْيَمِّ نَسْفًا

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا إِلَـٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا

translations.en.sahih: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
translations.en.transliteration: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran

verses.arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وِزْرًا

translations.en.sahih: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
translations.en.transliteration: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran

verses.arabic: خَالِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَاءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حِمْلًا

translations.en.sahih: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
translations.en.transliteration: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا

translations.en.sahih: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan

verses.arabic: يَتَخَافَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا

translations.en.sahih: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
translations.en.transliteration: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا

translations.en.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
translations.en.transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman

verses.arabic: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّي نَسْفًا

translations.en.sahih: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan

verses.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا

translations.en.sahih: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
translations.en.transliteration: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan

verses.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا

translations.en.sahih: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
translations.en.transliteration: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ الدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ الْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا

translations.en.sahih: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
translations.en.transliteration: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِيَ لَهُ قَوْلًا

translations.en.sahih: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِ عِلْمًا

translations.en.sahih: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.
translations.en.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman

verses.arabic: وَعَنَتِ الْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَيِّ الْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا

translations.en.sahih: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا

translations.en.sahih: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

verses.arabic: فَتَعَالَى اللَّهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا

translations.en.sahih: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
translations.en.transliteration: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَا إِلَىٰ آدَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِيَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُ عَزْمًا

translations.en.sahih: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ اسْجُدُوا لِآدَمَ فَسَجَدُوا إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>th</u> quln<u>a</u> lilmal<u>a</u>ikati osjudoo li<u>a</u>dama fasajadoo ill<u>a</u> ibleesa ab<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَا آدَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
translations.en.transliteration: Faquln<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> <u>a</u>damu inna h<u>atha</u> AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fal<u>a</u> yukhrijannakum<u>a</u> mina aljannati fatashq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna laka all<u>a</u> tajooAAa feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> taAAr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَأُ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
translations.en.transliteration: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha

verses.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ يَا آدَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ الْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
translations.en.transliteration: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla

verses.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰ آدَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
translations.en.transliteration: Faakal<u>a</u> minh<u>a</u> fabadat lahum<u>a</u> saw<u>a</u>tuhum<u>a</u> wa<u>t</u>afiq<u>a</u> yakh<u>s</u>if<u>a</u>ni AAalayhim<u>a</u> min waraqi aljannati waAAa<u>sa</u> <u>a</u>damu rabbahu faghaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ اجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma ijtab<u>a</u>hu rabbuhu fat<u>a</u>ba AAalayhi wahad<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَالَ اهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّي هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُدَايَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la ihbi<u>ta</u> minh<u>a</u> jameeAAan baAA<u>d</u>ukum libaAA<u>d</u>in AAaduwwun faimm<u>a</u> yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hud<u>a</u>ya fal<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>illu wal<u>a</u> yashq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَعْمَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
translations.en.transliteration: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِي أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ آيَاتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
translations.en.transliteration: Q<u>a</u>la ka<u>tha</u>lika atatka <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tun<u>a</u> fanaseetah<u>a</u> waka<u>tha</u>lika alyawma tuns<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِن بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
translations.en.transliteration: Waka<u>tha</u>lika najzee man asrafa walam yumin bi<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>ti rabbihi walaAAa<u>tha</u>bu al<u>a</u>khirati ashaddu waabq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
translations.en.transliteration: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى

translations.en.sahih: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
translations.en.transliteration: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
translations.en.transliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa

verses.arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّا أَهْلَكْنَاهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا لَوْلَا أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ آيَاتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw ann<u>a</u> ahlakn<u>a</u>hum biAAa<u>tha</u>bin min qablihi laq<u>a</u>loo rabban<u>a</u> lawl<u>a</u> arsalta ilayn<u>a</u> rasoolan fanattabiAAa <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tika min qabli an na<u>th</u>illa wanakhz<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada

verses.arabic: اقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
translations.en.transliteration: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona

verses.arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا اسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
translations.en.transliteration: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona

verses.arabic: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجْوَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا هَلْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ السِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ الْقَوْلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ بَلِ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِآيَةٍ كَمَا أُرْسِلَ الْأَوَّلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
translations.en.transliteration: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona

verses.arabic: مَا آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَا ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
translations.en.transliteration: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِي إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَاسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا خَالِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
translations.en.transliteration: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ الْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَاءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا الْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَابًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا أَحَسُّوا بَأْسَنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona

verses.arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا وَارْجِعُوا إِلَىٰ مَا أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
translations.en.transliteration: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَامِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
translations.en.transliteration: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَا أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّاتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا إِن كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
translations.en.transliteration: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ الْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
translations.en.transliteration: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona

verses.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
translations.en.transliteration: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona

verses.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا آلِهَةً مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
translations.en.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona

verses.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.en.transliteration: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: لَا يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
translations.en.transliteration: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona

verses.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِي ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
translations.en.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِي إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
translations.en.transliteration: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَانَهُ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
translations.en.transliteration: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
translations.en.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّي إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا السَّمَاءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ الْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ الْخَالِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَآكَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona

verses.arabic: خُلِقَ الْإِنسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِي فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

translations.en.sahih: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona
