translations.en.transliteration: Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ الظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan

verses.arabic: يَا وَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan

verses.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَاءَنِي ۗ وَكَانَ الشَّيْطَانُ لِلْإِنسَانِ خَذُولًا

translations.en.sahih: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الرَّسُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي اتَّخَذُوا هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ مَهْجُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِيٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ الْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ جُمْلَةً وَاحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur'an not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And they do not come to you with an argument except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُولَـٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُ أَخَاهُ هَارُونَ وَزِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا اذْهَبَا إِلَى الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَاهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ آيَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman

verses.arabic: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَ وَأَصْحَابَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And [We destroyed] 'Aad and Thamud and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran

verses.arabic: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ الْأَمْثَالَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا عَلَى الْقَرْيَةِ الَّتِي أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ السَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا الَّذِي بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسُولًا

translations.en.sahih: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allah has sent as a messenger?
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan

verses.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَا أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ الْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
translations.en.transliteration: In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan

verses.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
translations.en.transliteration: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَالْأَنْعَامِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
translations.en.transliteration: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا الشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَاهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهَارَ نُشُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ بُشْرًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran

verses.arabic: لِّنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
translations.en.transliteration: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَاهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا فَأَبَىٰ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِي كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran

verses.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْكَافِرِينَ وَجَاهِدْهُم بِهِ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran

verses.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ الْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
translations.en.transliteration: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْحَيِّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِ خَبِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
translations.en.transliteration: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۚ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَاسْأَلْ بِهِ خَبِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اسْجُدُوا لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا وَمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩

translations.en.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran

verses.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ فِي السَّمَاءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَاجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
translations.en.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran

verses.arabic: وَعِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ الْجَاهِلُونَ قَالُوا سَلَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
translations.en.transliteration: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا أَنفَقُوا لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman

verses.arabic: يُضَاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَانًا

translations.en.sahih: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
translations.en.transliteration: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَآمَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَأُولَـٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ حَسَنَاتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman

verses.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتَابًا

translations.en.sahih: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ الزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا كِرَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا

translations.en.sahih: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman

verses.arabic: خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا

translations.en.sahih: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
translations.en.transliteration: Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَأُ بِكُمْ رَبِّي لَوْلَا دُعَاؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman

verses.arabic: طسم

translations.en.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ta</u>seenmeem

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ

translations.en.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
translations.en.transliteration: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena

verses.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ آيَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَاقُهُمْ لَهَا خَاضِعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
translations.en.transliteration: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena

verses.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنبَاءُ مَا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ائْتِ الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
translations.en.transliteration: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena

verses.arabic: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qawma firAAawna ala yattaqoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

verses.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَارُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
translations.en.transliteration: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِآيَاتِنَا ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَا إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.transliteration: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
translations.en.transliteration: An arsil maAAana banee israeela

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
translations.en.transliteration: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena

verses.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
translations.en.transliteration: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَا إِذًا وَأَنَا مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena

verses.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِي رَبِّي حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
translations.en.transliteration: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela

verses.arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala firAAawnu wama rabbu alAAalameena

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala liman hawlahu ala tastamiAAoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِي لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ الْمَسْجُونِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَيْءٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala awalaw jituka bishayin mubeenin

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
translations.en.transliteration: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَاءُ لِلنَّاظِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
translations.en.transliteration: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَاحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun

verses.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
translations.en.transliteration: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena

verses.arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
translations.en.transliteration: Yatooka bikulli sahharin AAaleemin

verses.arabic: فَجُمِعَ السَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
translations.en.transliteration: FajumiAAa alssaharatu limeeqati yawmin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
translations.en.transliteration: Waqeela lilnnasi hal antum mujtamiAAoona

verses.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
translations.en.transliteration: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ أَلْقُوا مَا أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْغَالِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
translations.en.transliteration: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
translations.en.transliteration: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِيَ السَّحَرَةُ سَاجِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Faolqiya alssaharatu sajideena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi moosa waharoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ آمَنتُمْ لَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ آذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ الَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَافٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَايَانَا أَن كُنَّا أَوَّلَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena

verses.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
translations.en.transliteration: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي الْمَدَائِنِ حَاشِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
translations.en.transliteration: Faarsala firAAawnu fee almadaini hashireena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna haolai lashirthimatun qaleeloona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَائِظُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, they are enraging us,
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahum lana laghaithoona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَاذِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lajameeAAun hathiroona

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَاهُم مِّن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: So We removed them from gardens and springs
translations.en.transliteration: Faakhrajnahum min jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And treasures and honorable station -
translations.en.transliteration: Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareemin

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha banee israeela

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So they pursued them at sunrise.
translations.en.transliteration: FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى الْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.en.sahih: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
translations.en.transliteration: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ الْآخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waazlafna thamma alakhareena

verses.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahu ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned the others.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
translations.en.transliteration: Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheema

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
translations.en.transliteration: Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ith tadAAoona

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
translations.en.transliteration: Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا بَلْ وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
translations.en.transliteration: Qala afaraaytum ma kuntum taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمُ الْأَقْدَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: You and your ancient forefathers?
translations.en.transliteration: Antum waabaokumu alaqdamoona

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّي إِلَّا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeeni

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee huwa yutAAimunee wayasqeeni

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha maridtu fahuwa yashfeeni

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee yumeetunee thumma yuhyeeni

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
translations.en.transliteration: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena

verses.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: WaijAAalnee min warathati jannati alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِي إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الضَّالِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
translations.en.transliteration: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin

verses.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena

verses.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
translations.en.transliteration: Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaweena

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
translations.en.transliteration: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
translations.en.transliteration: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona

verses.arabic: فَكُبْكِبُوا فِيهَا هُمْ وَالْغَاوُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
translations.en.transliteration: Fakubkiboo feeha hum waalghawoona

verses.arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They will say while they dispute therein,
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoona

verses.arabic: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
translations.en.transliteration: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَضَلَّنَا إِلَّا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adallana illa almujrimoona

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So now we have no intercessors
translations.en.transliteration: Fama lana min shafiAAeena

verses.arabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And not a devoted friend.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala sadeeqin hameemin

verses.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
translations.en.transliteration: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied the messengers
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu noohin almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me."
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَاتَّبَعَكَ الْأَرْذَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo anuminu laka waittabaAAaka alarthaloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
translations.en.transliteration: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّي ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
translations.en.transliteration: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَنَا بِطَارِدِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama ana bitaridi almumineena

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: I am only a clear warner."
translations.en.transliteration: In ana illa natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا نُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمَرْجُومِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi inna qawmee kaththabooni

verses.arabic: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
translations.en.transliteration: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena

verses.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
translations.en.transliteration: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ الْبَاقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma aghraqna baAAdu albaqeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: 'Aad denied the messengers
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat AAadun almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
translations.en.transliteration: Atabnoona bikulli reeAAin ayatan taAAbathoona

verses.arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
translations.en.transliteration: Watattakhithoona masaniAAa laAAallakum takhludoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha batashtum batashtum jabbareena

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
translations.en.transliteration: Waittaqoo allathee amaddakum bima taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
translations.en.transliteration: Amaddakum bianAAamin wabaneena

verses.arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: And gardens and springs.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
translations.en.transliteration: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: قَالُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْنَا أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ الْوَاعِظِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena

verses.arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
translations.en.transliteration: In hatha illa khuluqu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And we are not to be punished."
translations.en.transliteration: Wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Thamud denied the messengers
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَا آمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
translations.en.transliteration: Atutrakoona fee ma hahuna amineena

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Within gardens and springs
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
translations.en.transliteration: WazurooAAin wanakhlin talAAuha hadeemun

verses.arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَارِهِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
translations.en.transliteration: Watanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan fariheena

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُطِيعُوا أَمْرَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tuteeAAoo amra almusrifeena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

verses.arabic: مَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا نَادِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
translations.en.transliteration: FaAAaqarooha faasbahoo nadimeena

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Lot denied the messengers
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَتَأْتُونَ الذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Do you approach males among the worlds
translations.en.transliteration: Atatoona alththukrana mina alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَاجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
translations.en.transliteration: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَا لُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُخْرَجِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ الْقَالِينَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
translations.en.transliteration: Qala innee liAAamalikum mina alqaleena

verses.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: فَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So We saved him and his family, all,
translations.en.transliteration: Fanajjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

verses.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
translations.en.transliteration: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththaba ashabu alaykati almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
translations.en.transliteration: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena

verses.arabic: وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And weigh with an even balance.
translations.en.transliteration: Wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

verses.arabic: وَاتَّقُوا الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَالْجِبِلَّةَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
translations.en.transliteration: Waittaqoo allathee khalaqakum waaljibillata alawwaleena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مِنَ الْمُسَحَّرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena

verses.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbee aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ الظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu latanzeelu rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ الرُّوحُ الْأَمِينُ

translations.en.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
translations.en.transliteration: Nazala bihi alrroohu alameenu

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُنذِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
translations.en.transliteration: AAala qalbika litakoona mina almunthireena

verses.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.
translations.en.transliteration: Bilisanin AAarabiyyin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu lafee zuburi alawwaleena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ الْأَعْجَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw nazzalnahu AAala baAAdi alaAAjameena

verses.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika salaknahu fee quloobi almujrimeena

verses.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا الْعَذَابَ الْأَلِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema

verses.arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
translations.en.transliteration: Fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

verses.arabic: فَيَقُولُوا هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
translations.en.transliteration: Fayaqooloo hal nahnu muntharoona

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
translations.en.transliteration: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraayta in mattaAAnahum sineena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَاءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma jaahum ma kanoo yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُمَتَّعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
translations.en.transliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona

verses.arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
translations.en.transliteration: Thikra wama kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ الشَّيَاطِينُ

translations.en.sahih: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tanazzalat bihi alshshayateenu

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yanbaghee lahum wama yastateeAAoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum AAani alssamAAi lamaAAzooloona

verses.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُعَذَّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الْأَقْرَبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanthir AAasheerataka alaqrabeena

verses.arabic: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
translations.en.transliteration: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
translations.en.transliteration: Watawakkal AAala alAAazeezi alrraheemi

verses.arabic: الَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

translations.en.sahih: Who sees you when you arise
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee yaraka heena taqoomu

verses.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السَّاجِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.
translations.en.transliteration: Wataqallubaka fee alssajideena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيَاطِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanazzalu AAala kulli affakin atheemin

verses.arabic: يُلْقُونَ السَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
translations.en.transliteration: Yulqoona alssamAAa waaktharuhum kathiboona

verses.arabic: وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
translations.en.transliteration: WaalshshuAAarao yattabiAAuhumu alghawoona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahum yaqooloona ma la yafAAaloona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَانتَصَرُوا مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona

verses.arabic: طس ۚ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ الْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
translations.en.transliteration: Taseen tilka ayatu alqurani wakitabin mubeenin

verses.arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
translations.en.transliteration: Hudan wabushra lilmumineena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ الزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati zayyanna lahum aAAmalahum fahum yaAAmahoona

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ هُمُ الْأَخْسَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika allatheena lahum sooo alAAathabi wahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْآنَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnaka latulaqqa alqurana min ladun hakeemin AAaleemin

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِ إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا سَآتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala moosa liahlihi innee anastu naran saateekum minha bikhabarin aw ateekum bishihabin qabasin laAAallakum tastaloona

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهَا نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ مَن فِي النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma jaaha noodiya an boorika man fee alnnari waman hawlaha wasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
translations.en.transliteration: Ya moosa innahu ana Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَانٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa la takhaf innee la yakhafu ladayya almursaloona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًا بَعْدَ سُوءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man thalama thumma baddala husnan baAAda sooin fainnee ghafoorun raheemun

verses.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ ۖ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
translations.en.transliteration: Waadkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin fee tisAAi ayatin ila firAAawna waqawmihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma jaathum ayatuna mubsiratan qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَجَحَدُوا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajahadoo biha waistayqanatha anfusuhum thulman waAAuluwwan faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْمًا ۖ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana AAilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana AAala katheerin min AAibadihi almumineena

verses.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
translations.en.transliteration: Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha alnnasu AAullimna mantiqa alttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeenu

verses.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni waalinsi waalttayri fahum yoozaAAoona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ النَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوا مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
