translations.en.sahih: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena kafaroo lahum AAathabun shadeedun waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سُوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَآهُ حَسَنًا ۖ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَاتٍ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]? For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. So do not let yourself perish over them in regret. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what they do.
translations.en.transliteration: Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka AAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yasnaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ الرِّيَاحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَسُقْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ مَّيِّتٍ فَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ النُّشُورُ

translations.en.sahih: And it is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds, and We drive them to a dead land and give life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Thus is the resurrection.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu allathee arsala alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha kathalika alnnushooru

verses.arabic: مَن كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ يَمْكُرُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۖ وَمَكْرُ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُوَ يَبُورُ

translations.en.sahih: Whoever desires honor [through power] - then to Allah belongs all honor. To Him ascends good speech, and righteous work raises it. But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
translations.en.transliteration: Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahi alAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu alttayyibu waalAAamalu alssalihu yarfaAAuhu waallatheena yamkuroona alssayyiati lahum AAathabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yabooru

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: And Allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates. And no female conceives nor does she give birth except with His knowledge. And no aged person is granted [additional] life nor is his lifespan lessened but that it is in a register. Indeed, that for Allah is easy.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin wala yunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْبَحْرَانِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ سَائِغٌ شَرَابُهُ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And not alike are the two bodies of water. One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter. And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yastawee albahrani hatha AAathbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

verses.arabic: يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.
translations.en.transliteration: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeerin

verses.arabic: إِن تَدْعُوهُمْ لَا يَسْمَعُوا دُعَاءَكُمْ وَلَوْ سَمِعُوا مَا اسْتَجَابُوا لَكُمْ ۖ وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَكْفُرُونَ بِشِرْكِكُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثْلُ خَبِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: If you invoke them, they do not hear your supplication; and if they heard, they would not respond to you. And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association. And none can inform you like [one] Acquainted [with all matters].
translations.en.transliteration: In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakum walaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeerin

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَنتُمُ الْفُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ

translations.en.sahih: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi waAllahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu

verses.arabic: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

translations.en.sahih: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.
translations.en.transliteration: In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin

verses.arabic: وَمَا ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزِيزٍ

translations.en.sahih: And that is for Allah not difficult.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِ ۚ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ الْمَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative. You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer. And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul. And to Allah is the [final] destination.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tadAAu muthqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi waaqamoo alssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseeru

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: Not equal are the blind and the seeing,
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru

verses.arabic: وَلَا الظُّلُمَاتُ وَلَا النُّورُ

translations.en.sahih: Nor are the darknesses and the light,
translations.en.transliteration: Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru

verses.arabic: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الْحَرُورُ

translations.en.sahih: Nor are the shade and the heat,
translations.en.transliteration: Wala alththillu wala alharooru

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِي الْأَحْيَاءُ وَلَا الْأَمْوَاتُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَاءُ ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍ مَّن فِي الْقُبُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori

verses.arabic: إِنْ أَنتَ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: You, [O Muhammad], are not but a warner.
translations.en.transliteration: In anta illa natheerun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ بِالْحَقِّ بَشِيرًا وَنَذِيرًا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that there had passed within it a warner.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheerun

verses.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالْكِتَابِ الْمُنِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: And if they deny you - then already have those before them denied. Their messengers came to them with clear proofs and written ordinances and with the enlightening Scripture.
translations.en.transliteration: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wabialzzuburi wabialkitabi almuneeri

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: Then I seized the ones who disbelieved, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeeri

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu soodun

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ النَّاسِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مُخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ كَذَٰلِكَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ غَفُورٌ

translations.en.sahih: And among people and moving creatures and grazing livestock are various colors similarly. Only those fear Allah, from among His servants, who have knowledge. Indeed, Allah is Exalted in Might and Forgiving.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنفَقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ سِرًّا وَعَلَانِيَةً يَرْجُونَ تِجَارَةً لَّن تَبُورَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who recite the Book of Allah and establish prayer and spend [in His cause] out of what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, [can] expect a profit that will never perish -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboora

verses.arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أُجُورَهُمْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ غَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

translations.en.sahih: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
translations.en.transliteration: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoorun

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبَادِهِ لَخَبِيرٌ بَصِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: And that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of the Book is the truth, confirming what was before it. Indeed, Allah, of His servants, is Acquainted and Seeing.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihi lakhabeerun baseerun

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْرَثْنَا الْكِتَابَ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَيْنَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۖ فَمِنْهُمْ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ وَمِنْهُم مُّقْتَصِدٌ وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: Then we caused to inherit the Book those We have chosen of Our servants; and among them is he who wrongs himself, and among them is he who is moderate, and among them is he who is foremost in good deeds by permission of Allah. That [inheritance] is what is the great bounty.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru

verses.arabic: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤْلُؤًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: [For them are] gardens of perpetual residence which they will enter. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their garments therein will be silk.
translations.en.transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ ۖ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative -
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun

verses.arabic: الَّذِي أَحَلَّنَا دَارَ الْمُقَامَةِ مِن فَضْلِهِ لَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا يَمَسُّنَا فِيهَا لُغُوبٌ

translations.en.sahih: He who has settled us in the home of duration out of His bounty. There touches us not in it any fatigue, and there touches us not in it weariness [of mind]."
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَهُمْ نَارُ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يُقْضَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَمُوتُوا وَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُم مِّنْ عَذَابِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي كُلَّ كَفُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: And for those who disbelieve will be the fire of Hell. [Death] is not decreed for them so they may die, nor will its torment be lightened for them. Thus do we recompense every ungrateful one.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ النَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us; we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!" But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment], for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihan ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awalam nuAAammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu alnnatheeru fathooqoo fama lilththalimeena min naseerin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَالِمُ غَيْبِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah is Knower of the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and earth. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi alssamawati waalardi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَكُمْ خَلَائِفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُ ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا مَقْتًا ۖ وَلَا يَزِيدُ الْكَافِرِينَ كُفْرُهُمْ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

translations.en.sahih: It is He who has made you successors upon the earth. And whoever disbelieves - upon him will be [the consequence of] his disbelief. And the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them in the sight of their Lord except in hatred; and the disbelief of the disbelievers does not increase them except in loss.
translations.en.transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ شُرَكَاءَكُمُ الَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ بَلْ إِن يَعِدُ الظَّالِمُونَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا إِلَّا غُرُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ أَن تَزُولَا ۚ وَلَئِن زَالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran

verses.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ لَئِن جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى الْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion.
translations.en.transliteration: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran

verses.arabic: اسْتِكْبَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ السَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ الْمَكْرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.
translations.en.transliteration: Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ۚ وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَلَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَلِيمًا قَدِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَابَّةٍ وَلَـٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِ بَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran

verses.arabic: يس

translations.en.sahih: Ya, Seen.
translations.en.transliteration: Y<u>a</u>seen

verses.arabic: وَالْقُرْآنِ الْحَكِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: By the wise Qur'an.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqurani alhakeemi

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
translations.en.transliteration: Innaka lamina almursaleena

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: On a straight path.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلَ الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi

verses.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا أُنذِرَ آبَاؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَافِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
translations.en.transliteration: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِي أَعْنَاقِهِمْ أَغْلَالًا فَهِيَ إِلَى الْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِن بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَاهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَسَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
translations.en.transliteration: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
translations.en.transliteration: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا وَآثَارَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَابَ الْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَاءَهَا الْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
translations.en.transliteration: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ اثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
translations.en.transliteration: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا مَا أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَا أَنزَلَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّا إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَا إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
translations.en.transliteration: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: قَالُوا طَائِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona

verses.arabic: وَجَاءَ مِنْ أَقْصَى الْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ اتَّبِعُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena

verses.arabic: اتَّبِعُوا مَن لَّا يَسْأَلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
translations.en.transliteration: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِيَ لَا أَعْبُدُ الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: أَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

translations.en.sahih: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
translations.en.transliteration: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni

verses.arabic: إِنِّي إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
translations.en.transliteration: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: إِنِّي آمَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَاسْمَعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
translations.en.transliteration: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni

verses.arabic: قِيلَ ادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ قَوْمِي يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
translations.en.transliteration: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ الْمُكْرَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
translations.en.transliteration: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ مِن بَعْدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena

verses.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَامِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
translations.en.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona

verses.arabic: يَا حَسْرَةً عَلَى الْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ الْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
translations.en.transliteration: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

verses.arabic: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الْأَرْضُ الْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَاهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
translations.en.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّاتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَابٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ الْعُيُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni

verses.arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
translations.en.transliteration: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمُ اللَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ النَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
translations.en.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona

verses.arabic: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِي لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

verses.arabic: وَالْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَاهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ الْقَدِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi

verses.arabic: لَا الشَّمْسُ يَنبَغِي لَهَا أَن تُدْرِكَ الْقَمَرَ وَلَا اللَّيْلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
translations.en.transliteration: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona

verses.arabic: وَآيَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِي الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
translations.en.transliteration: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona

verses.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
translations.en.transliteration: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ مِّنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَن بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona

verses.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
translations.en.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

verses.arabic: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئًا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ الْيَوْمَ فِي شُغُلٍ فَاكِهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona

verses.arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمْ فِي ظِلَالٍ عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ مُتَّكِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
translations.en.transliteration: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona

verses.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
translations.en.transliteration: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin

verses.arabic: وَامْتَازُوا الْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَا بَنِي آدَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا الشَّيْطَانَ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
translations.en.transliteration: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَأَنِ اعْبُدُونِي ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
translations.en.transliteration: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
translations.en.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: اصْلَوْهَا الْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
translations.en.transliteration: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

verses.arabic: الْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
translations.en.transliteration: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَمَسَخْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِي الْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
translations.en.transliteration: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَاهُ الشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْآنٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
translations.en.transliteration: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

verses.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ الْقَوْلُ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَا أَنْعَامًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَالِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

verses.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَاهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
translations.en.transliteration: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

verses.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
translations.en.transliteration: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

verses.arabic: وَاتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ آلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
translations.en.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
translations.en.transliteration: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْيِي الْعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

verses.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا الَّذِي أَنشَأَهَا أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

verses.arabic: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَا أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

verses.arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ الْخَلَّاقُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
translations.en.transliteration: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكُونُ

translations.en.sahih: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
translations.en.transliteration: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

verses.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَالصَّافَّاتِ صَفًّا

translations.en.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssaffati saffan

verses.arabic: فَالزَّاجِرَاتِ زَجْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]
translations.en.transliteration: Faalzzajirati zajran

verses.arabic: فَالتَّالِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who recite the message,
translations.en.transliteration: Faalttaliyati thikran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَـٰهَكُمْ لَوَاحِدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna ilahakum lawahidun

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ الْمَشَارِقِ

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ الْكَوَاكِبِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
translations.en.transliteration: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi

verses.arabic: وَحِفْظًا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ مَّارِدٍ

translations.en.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil
translations.en.transliteration: Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى الْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ

translations.en.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
translations.en.transliteration: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin

verses.arabic: دُحُورًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ وَاصِبٌ

translations.en.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
translations.en.transliteration: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ الْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ

translations.en.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun

verses.arabic: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَا ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
translations.en.transliteration: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin

verses.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,
translations.en.transliteration: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا لَا يَذْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا آيَةً يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
translations.en.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

verses.arabic: أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Awaabaona alawwaloona

verses.arabic: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَاخِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: احْشُرُوا الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَأَزْوَاجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا يَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
translations.en.transliteration: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona

verses.arabic: مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطِ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
translations.en.transliteration: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi

verses.arabic: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْئُولُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqifoohum innahum masooloona

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lakum la tanasaroona

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمُ الْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni

verses.arabic: قَالُوا بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَاغِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena

verses.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَا ۖ إِنَّا لَذَائِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
translations.en.transliteration: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona

verses.arabic: فَأَغْوَيْنَاكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَاوِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
translations.en.transliteration: Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُو آلِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin

verses.arabic: بَلْ جَاءَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَائِقُو الْعَذَابِ الْأَلِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
translations.en.transliteration: Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi

verses.arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun

verses.arabic: فَوَاكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored
translations.en.transliteration: Fawakihu wahum mukramoona

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: In gardens of pleasure
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: On thrones facing one another.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala sururin mutaqabileena

verses.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
translations.en.transliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin

verses.arabic: بَيْضَاءَ لَذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;
translations.en.transliteration: Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena

verses.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
translations.en.transliteration: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ عِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
translations.en.transliteration: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ أَإِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الْمُصَدِّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
translations.en.transliteration: Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena

verses.arabic: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
translations.en.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona

verses.arabic: فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِي سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi

verses.arabic: قَالَ تَاللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
translations.en.transliteration: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena

verses.arabic: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then, are we not to die
translations.en.transliteration: Afama nahnu bimayyiteena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
translations.en.transliteration: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

verses.arabic: لِمِثْلِ هَـٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ الْعَامِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
translations.en.transliteration: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona

verses.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ الزَّقُّومِ

translations.en.sahih: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
translations.en.transliteration: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهَا فِتْنَةً لِّلظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِي أَصْلِ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
translations.en.transliteration: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi

verses.arabic: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُ رُءُوسُ الشَّيَاطِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
translations.en.transliteration: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu alshshayateeni

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَآكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا آبَاءَهُمْ ضَالِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena

verses.arabic: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
translations.en.transliteration: Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena

verses.arabic: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
translations.en.transliteration: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَادَانَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ الْمُجِيبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad nadana noohun falaniAAma almujeeboona

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُ هُمُ الْبَاقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humu albaqeena

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun AAala noohin fee alAAalameena

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِ لَإِبْرَاهِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna min sheeAAatihi laibraheema

verses.arabic: إِذْ جَاءَ رَبَّهُ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
translations.en.transliteration: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbin saleemin

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: أَئِفْكًا آلِهَةً دُونَ اللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
translations.en.transliteration: Aifkan alihatan doona Allahi tureedoona

verses.arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
translations.en.transliteration: Fama thannukum birabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي النُّجُومِ

translations.en.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars
translations.en.transliteration: Fanathara nathratan fee alnnujoomi

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
translations.en.transliteration: Faqala innee saqeemun

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireena

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
translations.en.transliteration: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lakum la tantiqoona

verses.arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًا بِالْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
translations.en.transliteration: Faragha AAalayhim darban bialyameeni

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوا إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
translations.en.transliteration: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoona

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum wama taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا ابْنُوا لَهُ بُنْيَانًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi

verses.arabic: فَأَرَادُوا بِهِ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ الْأَسْفَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni

verses.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mina alssaliheena

verses.arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلَامٍ حَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
translations.en.transliteration: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleemin

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعْيَ قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ فِي الْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَا أَبَتِ افْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِي إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma aslama watallahu liljabeeni

verses.arabic: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: We called to him, "O Abraham,
translations.en.transliteration: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheemu

verses.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ الرُّؤْيَا ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ الْبَلَاءُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha lahuwa albalao almubeenu

verses.arabic: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
translations.en.transliteration: Wafadaynahu bithibhin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Abraham."
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun AAala ibraheema

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

verses.arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Wabashsharnahu biishaqa nabiyyan mina alssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
translations.en.transliteration: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad mananna AAala moosa waharoona

verses.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ الْكَرْبِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
translations.en.transliteration: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahuma mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُوا هُمُ الْغَالِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanasarnahum fakanoo humu alghalibeena

verses.arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا الْكِتَابَ الْمُسْتَبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
translations.en.transliteration: Waataynahuma alkitaba almustabeena

verses.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahadaynahuma alssirata almustaqeema

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun AAala moosa waharoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala liqawmihi ala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
translations.en.transliteration: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena

verses.arabic: اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
translations.en.transliteration: Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
translations.en.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu fainnahum lamuhdaroona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
translations.en.transliteration: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ

translations.en.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun AAala il yaseena

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
translations.en.transliteration: Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِي الْغَابِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا الْآخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena

verses.arabic: وَبِاللَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
translations.en.transliteration: Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى الْفُلْكِ الْمَشْحُونِ

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
translations.en.transliteration: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni

verses.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena

verses.arabic: فَالْتَقَمَهُ الْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
translations.en.transliteration: Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
translations.en.transliteration: Falawla annahu kana mina almusabbiheena

verses.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
translations.en.transliteration: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
translations.en.transliteration: Fanabathnahu bialAAarai wahuwa saqeemun

verses.arabic: وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan min yaqteenin

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِائَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
translations.en.transliteration: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona

verses.arabic: فَآمَنُوا فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
translations.en.transliteration: Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ila heenin

verses.arabic: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ الْبَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
translations.en.transliteration: Faistaftihim alirabbika albanatu walahumu albanoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلَائِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
translations.en.transliteration: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona

verses.arabic: أَلَا إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
