translations.en.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
translations.en.transliteration: Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloona

verses.arabic: وَلَدَ اللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
translations.en.transliteration: Walada Allahu wainnahum lakathiboona

verses.arabic: أَصْطَفَى الْبَنَاتِ عَلَى الْبَنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
translations.en.transliteration: Astafa albanati AAala albaneena

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?
translations.en.transliteration: Afala tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?
translations.en.transliteration: Am lakum sultanun mubeenun

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatoo bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ الْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
translations.en.transliteration: Subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnakum wama taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: مَا أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَاتِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
translations.en.transliteration: Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man huwa sali aljaheemi

verses.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّا إِلَّا لَهُ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الصَّافُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lanahnu alssaffoona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ الْمُسَبِّحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lanahnu almusabbihoona

verses.arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا لَيَقُولُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
translations.en.transliteration: Wain kanoo layaqooloona

verses.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
translations.en.transliteration: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena

verses.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
translations.en.transliteration: Lakunna AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: فَكَفَرُوا بِهِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadina almursaleena

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ الْمَنصُورُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum lahumu almansooroona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ الْغَالِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna jundana lahumu alghaliboona

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
translations.en.transliteration: Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroona

verses.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
translations.en.transliteration: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَاءَ صَبَاحُ الْمُنذَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena

verses.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And leave them for a time.
translations.en.transliteration: Watawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

verses.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.
translations.en.transliteration: Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroona

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
translations.en.transliteration: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wasalamun AAala almursaleena

verses.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: ص ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ

translations.en.sahih: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
translations.en.transliteration: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri

verses.arabic: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

translations.en.sahih: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
translations.en.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin

verses.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

translations.en.sahih: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
translations.en.transliteration: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin

verses.arabic: وَعَجِبُوا أَن جَاءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

translations.en.sahih: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun

verses.arabic: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ

translations.en.sahih: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
translations.en.transliteration: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun

verses.arabic: وَانطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ

translations.en.sahih: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
translations.en.transliteration: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu

verses.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ

translations.en.sahih: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

verses.arabic: أَأُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
translations.en.transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
translations.en.transliteration: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi

verses.arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ الْأَحْزَابِ

translations.en.sahih: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
translations.en.transliteration: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ

translations.en.sahih: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
translations.en.transliteration: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu

verses.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
translations.en.transliteration: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

translations.en.sahih: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi

verses.arabic: اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

translations.en.sahih: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi

verses.arabic: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

translations.en.sahih: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
translations.en.transliteration: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun

verses.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ

translations.en.sahih: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
translations.en.transliteration: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ

translations.en.sahih: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
translations.en.transliteration: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba

verses.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ

translations.en.sahih: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
translations.en.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩

translations.en.sahih: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba

verses.arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

translations.en.sahih: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
translations.en.transliteration: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

verses.arabic: يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari

verses.arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
translations.en.transliteration: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari

verses.arabic: كِتَابٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
translations.en.transliteration: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

translations.en.sahih: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ

translations.en.sahih: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
translations.en.transliteration: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ

translations.en.sahih: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
translations.en.transliteration: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi

verses.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ

translations.en.sahih: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
translations.en.transliteration: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu

verses.arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

translations.en.sahih: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
translations.en.transliteration: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba

verses.arabic: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
translations.en.transliteration: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin

verses.arabic: وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ

translations.en.sahih: And others bound together in shackles.
translations.en.transliteration: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

translations.en.sahih: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin

verses.arabic: ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

translations.en.sahih: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
translations.en.transliteration: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun

verses.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi

verses.arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِب بِّهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ

translations.en.sahih: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ

translations.en.sahih: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
translations.en.transliteration: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ

translations.en.sahih: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ

translations.en.sahih: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin

verses.arabic: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ

translations.en.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
translations.en.transliteration: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

translations.en.sahih: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin

verses.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

translations.en.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ

translations.en.sahih: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِن نَّفَادٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ

translations.en.sahih: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin

verses.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ

translations.en.sahih: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
translations.en.transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

translations.en.sahih: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun

verses.arabic: وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ

translations.en.sahih: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
translations.en.transliteration: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari

verses.arabic: قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu

verses.arabic: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ الْأَشْرَارِ

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari

verses.arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ

translations.en.sahih: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
translations.en.transliteration: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

verses.arabic: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "It is great news
translations.en.transliteration: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun

verses.arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: From which you turn away.
translations.en.transliteration: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
translations.en.transliteration: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona

verses.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
translations.en.transliteration: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
translations.en.transliteration: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

verses.arabic: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِي مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِن طِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنظَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
translations.en.transliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ

translations.en.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
translations.en.transliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
translations.en.transliteration: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
translations.en.transliteration: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu

verses.arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
translations.en.transliteration: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
translations.en.transliteration: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

verses.arabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِي مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَنْ هُوَ كَاذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ

translations.en.sahih: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
translations.en.transliteration: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun

verses.arabic: لَّوْ أَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّاصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ ۖ هُوَ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ

translations.en.sahih: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
translations.en.transliteration: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ اللَّيْلَ عَلَى النَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهَارَ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ

translations.en.sahih: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
translations.en.transliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru

verses.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّن بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
translations.en.transliteration: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona

verses.arabic: إِن تَكْفُرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ الْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

translations.en.sahih: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
translations.en.transliteration: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَائِمًا يَحْذَرُ الْآخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُو رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَـٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ اللَّهِ وَاسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى الصَّابِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ الدِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

verses.arabic: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
translations.en.transliteration: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّي عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ دِينِي

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
translations.en.transliteration: Quli All<u>a</u>ha aAAbudu mukhli<u>s</u>an lahu deenee

verses.arabic: فَاعْبُدُوا مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْخُسْرَانُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
translations.en.transliteration: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu

verses.arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ النَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبَادَهُ ۚ يَا عِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِ

translations.en.sahih: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ اجْتَنَبُوا الطَّاغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ الْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ

translations.en.sahih: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ الْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ ۖ وَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi

verses.arabic: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari

verses.arabic: لَـٰكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌ مَّبْنِيَّةٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۖ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ الْمِيعَادَ

translations.en.sahih: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
translations.en.transliteration: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ

translations.en.sahih: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.
translations.en.transliteration: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيثِ كِتَابًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهْدِي بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ

translations.en.sahih: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِي بِوَجْهِهِ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّالِمِينَ ذُوقُوا مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
translations.en.transliteration: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَاهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

verses.arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الْخِزْيَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
translations.en.transliteration: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

verses.arabic: قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِي عِوَجٍ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلًا فِيهِ شُرَكَاءُ مُتَشَاكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
translations.en.transliteration: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَاءَهُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
translations.en.transliteration: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي جَاءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ ۙ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُتَّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona

verses.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَاءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَاءُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
translations.en.transliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena

verses.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ هَادٍ

translations.en.sahih: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
translations.en.transliteration: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍ ذِي انتِقَامٍ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَاشِفَاتُ ضُرِّهِ أَوْ أَرَادَنِي بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَاتُ رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ ۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "Allah." Say, "Then have you considered what you invoke besides Allah? If Allah intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?" Say, "Sufficient for me is Allah; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers."
translations.en.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا قَوْمِ اعْمَلُوا عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّي عَامِلٌ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابٌ مُّقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment."
translations.en.transliteration: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَا أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a manager over them.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الْأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالَّتِي لَمْ تَمُتْ فِي مَنَامِهَا ۖ فَيُمْسِكُ الَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيْهَا الْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ الْأُخْرَىٰ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

verses.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعَاءَ ۚ قُلْ أَوَلَوْ كَانُوا لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَيْئًا وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they taken other than Allah as intercessors? Say, "Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?"
translations.en.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّهِ الشَّفَاعَةُ جَمِيعًا ۖ لَّهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "To Allah belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اشْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ الَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona

verses.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِي مَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ."
translations.en.transliteration: Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافْتَدَوْا بِهِ مِن سُوءِ الْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُوا يَحْتَسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from Allah that which they had not taken into account.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw anna lillatheena thalamoo ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi min sooi alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboona

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
translations.en.transliteration: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ ضُرٌّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَاهُ نِعْمَةً مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ ۚ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةٌ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favor from Us, he says, "I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge." Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha massa alinsana durrun daAAana thumma itha khawwalnahu niAAmatan minna qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: قَدْ قَالَهَا الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
translations.en.transliteration: Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا ۚ وَالَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا كَسَبُوا وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be afflicted by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not cause failure.
translations.en.transliteration: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo waallatheena thalamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimuAAjizeena

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do they not know that Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

verses.arabic: وَأَنِيبُوا إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُوا لَهُ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
translations.en.transliteration: Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu thumma la tunsaroona

verses.arabic: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمُ الْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةً وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
translations.en.transliteration: WaittabiAAoo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu baghtatan waantum la tashAAuroona

verses.arabic: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسٌ يَا حَسْرَتَىٰ عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطتُ فِي جَنبِ اللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ السَّاخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Lest a soul should say, "Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to Allah and that I was among the mockers."
translations.en.transliteration: An taqoola nafsun ya hasrata AAala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina alssakhireena

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدَانِي لَكُنتُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Or [lest] it say, "If only Allah had guided me, I would have been among the righteous."
translations.en.transliteration: Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeena

verses.arabic: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَى الْعَذَابَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي كَرَّةً فَأَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, "If only I had another turn so I could be among the doers of good."
translations.en.transliteration: Aw taqoola heena tara alAAathaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineena

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَتْكَ آيَاتِي فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha waistakbarta wakunta mina alkafireena

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَرَى الَّذِينَ كَذَبُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِي جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًى لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about Allah [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
translations.en.transliteration: Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo AAala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireena

verses.arabic: وَيُنَجِّي اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ السُّوءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Allah will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayunajjee Allahu allatheena ittaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu alssooo wala hum yahzanoona

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ خَالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَكِيلٌ

translations.en.sahih: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa AAala kulli shayin wakeelun

verses.arabic: لَّهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْخَاسِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of Allah - it is those who are the losers.
translations.en.transliteration: Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi olaika humu alkhasiroona

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَفَغَيْرَ اللَّهِ تَأْمُرُونِّي أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا الْجَاهِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qul afaghayra Allahi tamuroonnee aAAbudu ayyuha aljahiloona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنْ أَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with Allah, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad oohiya ilayka waila allatheena min qablika lain ashrakta layahbatanna AAamaluka walatakoonanna mina alkhasireena

verses.arabic: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Bali Allaha faoAAbud wakun mina alshshakireena

verses.arabic: وَمَا قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِ وَالْأَرْضُ جَمِيعًا قَبْضَتُهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَالسَّمَاوَاتُ مَطْوِيَّاتٌ بِيَمِينِهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi waalardu jameeAAan qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati waalssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

verses.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْرَىٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامٌ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori fasaAAiqa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu thumma nufikha feehi okhra faitha hum qiyamun yanthuroona

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرَقَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ الْكِتَابُ وَجِيءَ بِالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
translations.en.transliteration: Waashraqati alardu binoori rabbiha wawudiAAa alkitabu wajeea bialnnabiyyeena waalshshuhadai waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

verses.arabic: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahuwa aAAlamu bima yafAAaloona

verses.arabic: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوهَا فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ رُسُلٌ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا ۚ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, "Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They will say, "Yes, but the word of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waseeqa allatheena kafaroo ila jahannama zumaran hatta itha jaooha futihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatloona AAalaykum ayati rabbikum wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo bala walakin haqqat kalimatu alAAathabi AAala alkafireena

verses.arabic: قِيلَ ادْخُلُوا أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [To them] it will be said, "Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
translations.en.transliteration: Qeela odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireena

verses.arabic: وَسِيقَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ زُمَرًا ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَالِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
translations.en.transliteration: Waseeqa allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum ila aljannati zumaran hatta itha jaooha wafutihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha salamun AAalaykum tibtum faodkhulooha khalideena

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُ وَأَوْرَثَنَا الْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَاءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ الْعَامِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "Praise to Allah, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee sadaqana waAAdahu waawrathana alarda natabawwao mina aljannati haythu nashao faniAAma ajru alAAamileena

verses.arabic: وَتَرَى الْمَلَائِكَةَ حَافِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ الْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ ۖ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَقِيلَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [Allah] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, "[All] praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
translations.en.transliteration: Watara almalaikata haffeena min hawli alAAarshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi waqeela alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: حم

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ha</u>meem

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْعَلِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

verses.arabic: غَافِرِ الذَّنبِ وَقَابِلِ التَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ الْعِقَابِ ذِي الطَّوْلِ ۖ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ إِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
translations.en.transliteration: Ghafiri alththanbi waqabili alttawbi shadeedi alAAiqabi thee alttawli la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaseeru

verses.arabic: مَا يُجَادِلُ فِي آيَاتِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِي الْبِلَادِ

translations.en.sahih: No one disputes concerning the signs of Allah except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma yujadilu fee ayati Allahi illa allatheena kafaroo fala yaghrurka taqallubuhum fee albiladi

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَالْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ ۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ ۖ وَجَادَلُوا بِالْبَاطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا بِهِ الْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ ۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waalahzabu min baAAdihim wahammat kullu ommatin birasoolihim liyakhuthoohu wajadaloo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa faakhathtuhum fakayfa kana AAiqabi

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika AAala allatheena kafaroo annahum ashabu alnnari

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ الْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yahmiloona alAAarsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayuminoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lillatheena amanoo rabbana wasiAAta kulla shayin rahmatan waAAilman faighfir lillatheena taboo waittabaAAoo sabeelaka waqihim AAathaba aljaheemi

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbana waadkhilhum jannati AAadnin allatee waAAadtahum waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu

verses.arabic: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqihimu alssayyiati waman taqi alssayyiati yawmaithin faqad rahimtahu wathalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى الْإِيمَانِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allah for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you refused."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo yunadawna lamaqtu Allahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum ith tudAAawna ila aleemani fatakfuroona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا أَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo rabbana amattana ithnatayni waahyaytana ithnatayni faiAAtarafna bithunoobina fahal ila khuroojin min sabeelin

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُ إِذَا دُعِيَ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ كَفَرْتُمْ ۖ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِ تُؤْمِنُوا ۚ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْكَبِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah, the Most High, the Grand."
translations.en.transliteration: Thalikum biannahu itha duAAiya Allahu wahdahu kafartum wain yushrak bihi tuminoo faalhukmu lillahi alAAaliyyi alkabeeri

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي يُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ رِزْقًا ۚ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ

translations.en.sahih: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
translations.en.transliteration: Huwa allathee yureekum ayatihi wayunazzilu lakum mina alssamai rizqan wama yatathakkaru illa man yuneebu

verses.arabic: فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So invoke Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
translations.en.transliteration: FaodAAoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena walaw kariha alkafiroona

verses.arabic: رَفِيعُ الدَّرَجَاتِ ذُو الْعَرْشِ يُلْقِي الرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ

translations.en.sahih: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
translations.en.transliteration: RafeeAAu alddarajati thoo alAAarshi yulqee alrrooha min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi liyunthira yawma alttalaqi

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ هُم بَارِزُونَ ۖ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَيْءٌ ۚ لِّمَنِ الْمُلْكُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ لِلَّهِ الْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma hum barizoona la yakhfa AAala Allahi minhum shayon limani almulku alyawma lillahi alwahidi alqahhari

verses.arabic: الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ ۚ لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

translations.en.sahih: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
translations.en.transliteration: Alyawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la thulma alyawma inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi

verses.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ

translations.en.sahih: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
