verses.arabic: وَتَرَاهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَاشِعِينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِيٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ الْخَاسِرِينَ الَّذِينَ خَسِرُوا أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ فِي عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
translations.en.transliteration: Watarahum yuAAradoona AAalayha khashiAAeena mina alththulli yanthuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna alththalimeena fee AAathabin muqeemin

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَاءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ اللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُ مِن سَبِيلٍ

translations.en.sahih: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah. And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeelin

verses.arabic: اسْتَجِيبُوا لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.
translations.en.transliteration: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeerin

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا فَمَا أَرْسَلْنَاكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا الْبَلَاغُ ۗ وَإِنَّا إِذَا أَذَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ كَفُورٌ

translations.en.sahih: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Fain aAAradoo fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan in AAalayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoorun

verses.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ إِنَاثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ الذُّكُورَ

translations.en.sahih: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
translations.en.transliteration: Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao alththukoora

verses.arabic: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
translations.en.transliteration: Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayajAAalu man yashao AAaqeeman innahu AAaleemun qadeerun

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu AAaliyyun hakeemun

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْإِيمَانُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِي بِهِ مَن نَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
translations.en.transliteration: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: صِرَاطِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصِيرُ الْأُمُورُ

translations.en.sahih: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.
translations.en.transliteration: Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomooru

verses.arabic: حم

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ha</u>meem

verses.arabic: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ

translations.en.sahih: By the clear Book,
translations.en.transliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni

verses.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
translations.en.transliteration: Inn<u>a</u> jaAAaln<u>a</u>hu qur<u>a</u>nan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ فِي أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِيٌّ حَكِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun

verses.arabic: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
translations.en.transliteration: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena

verses.arabic: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِيٍّ فِي الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
translations.en.transliteration: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: فَأَهْلَكْنَا أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
translations.en.transliteration: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الْعَزِيزُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
translations.en.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي خَلَقَ الْأَزْوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْفُلْكِ وَالْأَنْعَامِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona

verses.arabic: لِتَسْتَوُوا عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا اسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
translations.en.transliteration: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا لَهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَاكُم بِالْبَنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
translations.en.transliteration: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

verses.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّأُ فِي الْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِي الْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
translations.en.transliteration: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَاثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْأَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَوْ شَاءَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَاهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ آتَيْنَاهُمْ كِتَابًا مِّن قَبْلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
translations.en.transliteration: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
translations.en.transliteration: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَا إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
translations.en.transliteration: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ آبَاءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا إِنَّا بِمَا أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِ كَافِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

verses.arabic: فَانتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّنِي بَرَاءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
translations.en.transliteration: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِي فَطَرَنِي فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
translations.en.transliteration: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةً بَاقِيَةً فِي عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ وَآبَاءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَاءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِ كَافِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
translations.en.transliteration: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا الْقُرْآنُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَاتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
translations.en.transliteration: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا أَن يَكُونَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِالرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
translations.en.transliteration: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona

verses.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَابًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
translations.en.transliteration: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona

verses.arabic: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ وَالْآخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُ شَيْطَانًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَنَا قَالَ يَا لَيْتَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu

verses.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ الْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

verses.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَمَن كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
translations.en.transliteration: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona

verses.arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِي وَعَدْنَاهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.transliteration: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona

verses.arabic: فَاسْتَمْسِكْ بِالَّذِي أُوحِيَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
translations.en.transliteration: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْأَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona

verses.arabic: وَاسْأَلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ آلِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
translations.en.transliteration: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِآيَاتِنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُم بِآيَاتِنَا إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ آيَةٍ إِلَّا هِيَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَاهُم بِالْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
translations.en.transliteration: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا يَا أَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ الْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona

verses.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِي قَوْمِهِ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِي مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ الْأَنْهَارُ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِي ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
translations.en.transliteration: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
translations.en.transliteration: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
translations.en.transliteration: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena

verses.arabic: فَاسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا انتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَاهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
translations.en.transliteration: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا أَآلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
translations.en.transliteration: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَائِكَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ ۖ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

verses.arabic: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
translations.en.transliteration: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin

verses.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا السَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

verses.arabic: الْأَخِلَّاءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا الْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
translations.en.transliteration: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena

verses.arabic: يَا عِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَا أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
translations.en.transliteration: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena

verses.arabic: ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
translations.en.transliteration: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona

verses.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ الْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
translations.en.transliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona

verses.arabic: وَتِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِي أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
translations.en.transliteration: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona

verses.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
translations.en.transliteration: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona

verses.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا هُمُ الظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَنَادَوْا يَا مَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّاكِثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
translations.en.transliteration: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوا أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
translations.en.transliteration: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
translations.en.transliteration: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْعَابِدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena

verses.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
translations.en.transliteration: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِي فِي السَّمَاءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ الْحَكِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ اللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
translations.en.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

verses.arabic: وَقِيلِهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona

verses.arabic: فَاصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَامٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: حم

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ha</u>meem

verses.arabic: وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ

translations.en.sahih: By the clear Book,
translations.en.transliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
translations.en.transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
translations.en.transliteration: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin

verses.arabic: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
translations.en.transliteration: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

verses.arabic: لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
translations.en.transliteration: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona

verses.arabic: فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
translations.en.transliteration: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
translations.en.transliteration: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
translations.en.transliteration: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي آتِيكُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
translations.en.transliteration: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ

translations.en.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
translations.en.transliteration: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
translations.en.transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
translations.en.transliteration: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
translations.en.transliteration: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
translations.en.transliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And crops and noble sites
translations.en.transliteration: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.
translations.en.transliteration: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنظَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
translations.en.transliteration: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
translations.en.transliteration: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
translations.en.transliteration: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna haolai layaqooloona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
translations.en.transliteration: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
translations.en.transliteration: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Is food for the sinful.
translations.en.transliteration: TaAAamu alatheemi

verses.arabic: كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ

translations.en.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
translations.en.transliteration: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni

verses.arabic: كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaghalyi alhameemi

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
translations.en.transliteration: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
translations.en.transliteration: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Within gardens and springs,
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَابِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ آمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
translations.en.transliteration: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
translations.en.transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi

verses.arabic: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
translations.en.transliteration: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

verses.arabic: فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
translations.en.transliteration: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona

verses.arabic: حم

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ha</u>meem

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ لَآيَاتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena

verses.arabic: وَفِي خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَابَّةٍ آيَاتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
translations.en.transliteration: Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona

verses.arabic: وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ الرِّيَاحِ آيَاتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
translations.en.transliteration: Waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin yaAAqiloona

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ آيَاتُ اللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَ اللَّهِ وَآيَاتِهِ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
translations.en.transliteration: Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin baAAda Allahi waayatihi yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Woe to every sinful liar
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun likulli affakin atheemin

verses.arabic: يَسْمَعُ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: YasmaAAu ayati Allahi tutla AAalayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا شَيْئًا اتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha AAalima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun

verses.arabic: مِّن وَرَائِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا شَيْئًا وَلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee AAanhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum AAathabun AAatheemun

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

verses.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
translations.en.transliteration: Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jameeAAan minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَغْفِرُوا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجْزِيَ قَوْمًا بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَاءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
translations.en.transliteration: Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَاهُم مِّنَ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَفَضَّلْنَاهُمْ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُم بَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ بَغْيًا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِي بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
translations.en.transliteration: Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَاءَ الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma jaAAalnaka AAala shareeAAatin mina alamri faittabiAAha wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا عَنكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۚ وَإِنَّ الظَّالِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَاللَّهُ وَلِيُّ الْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum lan yughnoo AAanka mina Allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waAllahu waliyyu almuttaqeena

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا بَصَائِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
translations.en.transliteration: Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an najAAalahum kaallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُ هَوَاهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِ غِشَاوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِن بَعْدِ اللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu AAala AAilmin wakhatama AAala samAAihi waqalbihi wajaAAala AAala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min baAAdi Allahi afala tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَا إِلَّا الدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yathunnoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا ائْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
translations.en.transliteration: Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajmaAAukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
translations.en.transliteration: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona

verses.arabic: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰ إِلَىٰ كِتَابِهَا الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tudAAa ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا كِتَابُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِالْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha kitabuna yantiqu AAalaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِي مَا السَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha qeela inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waalssaAAatu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssaAAatu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena

verses.arabic: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّئَاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
translations.en.transliteration: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنسَاكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَأْوَاكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّاصِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona

verses.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

verses.arabic: حم

translations.en.sahih: Ha, Meem.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Ha</u>meem

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ مِنَ اللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَمَّا أُنذِرُوا مُعْرِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقُوا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ ۖ ائْتُونِي بِكِتَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَا أَوْ أَثَارَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul araaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min AAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُو مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَائِهِمْ غَافِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman adallu mimman yadAAoo min dooni Allahi man la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati wahum AAan duAAaihim ghafiloona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ النَّاسُ كَانُوا لَهُمْ أَعْدَاءً وَكَانُوا بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ كَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha hushira alnnasu kanoo lahum aAAdaan wakanoo biAAibadatihim kafireena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتُنَا بَيِّنَاتٍ قَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ ۖ قُلْ إِنِ افْتَرَيْتُهُ فَلَا تَمْلِكُونَ لِي مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ ۖ كَفَىٰ بِهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."
translations.en.transliteration: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fala tamlikoona lee mina Allahi shayan huwa aAAlamu bima tufeedoona feehi kafa bihi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَا كُنتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَا أَدْرِي مَا يُفْعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمْ ۖ إِنْ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ma kuntu bidAAan mina alrrusuli wama adree ma yufAAalu bee wala bikum in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya wama ana illa natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن كَانَ مِنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرْتُم بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّن بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَىٰ مِثْلِهِ فَآمَنَ وَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَوْ كَانَ خَيْرًا مَّا سَبَقُونَا إِلَيْهِ ۚ وَإِذْ لَمْ يَهْتَدُوا بِهِ فَسَيَقُولُونَ هَـٰذَا إِفْكٌ قَدِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo law kana khayran ma sabaqoona ilayhi waith lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona hatha ifkun qadeemun

verses.arabic: وَمِن قَبْلِهِ كِتَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ وَهَـٰذَا كِتَابٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّسَانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّيُنذِرَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan wahatha kitabun musaddiqun lisanan AAarabiyyan liyunthira allatheena thalamoo wabushra lilmuhsineena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
translations.en.transliteration: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawadaAAathu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaAAeena sanatan qala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeena

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنْهُمْ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا وَنَتَجَاوَزُ عَن سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ فِي أَصْحَابِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَعْدَ الصِّدْقِ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu AAanhum ahsana ma AAamiloo wanatajawazu AAan sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati waAAda alssidqi allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي قَالَ لِوَالِدَيْهِ أُفٍّ لَّكُمَا أَتَعِدَانِنِي أَنْ أُخْرَجَ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ الْقُرُونُ مِن قَبْلِي وَهُمَا يَسْتَغِيثَانِ اللَّهَ وَيْلَكَ آمِنْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقُولُ مَا هَـٰذَا إِلَّا أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people" -
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ataAAidaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِي أُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا خَاسِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena

verses.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجَاتٌ مِّمَّا عَمِلُوا ۖ وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
translations.en.transliteration: Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo waliyuwaffiyahum aAAmalahum wahum la yuthlamoona

verses.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا فَالْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْسُقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
translations.en.transliteration: Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu alddunya waistamtaAAtum biha faalyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoona

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkur akha AAadin ith anthara qawmahu bialahqafi waqad khalati alnnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: قَالُوا أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ آلِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ajitana litafikana AAan alihatina fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena

verses.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم مَّا أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ وَلَـٰكِنِّي أَرَاكُمْ قَوْمًا تَجْهَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
translations.en.transliteration: Qala innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ عَارِضًا مُّسْتَقْبِلَ أَوْدِيَتِهِمْ قَالُوا هَـٰذَا عَارِضٌ مُّمْطِرُنَا ۚ بَلْ هُوَ مَا اسْتَعْجَلْتُم بِهِ ۖ رِيحٌ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
