translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

verses.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: فَفِرُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
translations.en.transliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا آخَرَ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَا أَتَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

verses.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا بِهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
translations.en.transliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

verses.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ الذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

verses.arabic: مَا أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

translations.en.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

verses.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن يَوْمِهِمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
translations.en.transliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَالطُّورِ

translations.en.sahih: By the mount
translations.en.transliteration: Waalttoori

verses.arabic: وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed
translations.en.transliteration: Wakitabin mastoorin

verses.arabic: فِي رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: In parchment spread open
translations.en.transliteration: Fee raqqin manshoorin

verses.arabic: وَالْبَيْتِ الْمَعْمُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the frequented House
translations.en.transliteration: Waalbayti almaAAmoori

verses.arabic: وَالسَّقْفِ الْمَرْفُوعِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the heaven raised high
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi

verses.arabic: وَالْبَحْرِ الْمَسْجُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
translations.en.transliteration: Waalbahri almasjoori

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun

verses.arabic: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ

translations.en.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lahu min dafiAAin

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran

verses.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ الْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
translations.en.transliteration: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
translations.en.transliteration: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

translations.en.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan

verses.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
translations.en.transliteration: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
translations.en.transliteration: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona

verses.arabic: اصْلَوْهَا فَاصْبِرُوا أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
translations.en.transliteration: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin

verses.arabic: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَا آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi

verses.arabic: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَاتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَا أَلَتْنَاهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun

verses.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
translations.en.transliteration: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona

verses.arabic: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
translations.en.transliteration: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun

verses.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِي أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena

verses.arabic: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ السَّمُومِ

translations.en.sahih: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْبَرُّ الرَّحِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
translations.en.transliteration: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
translations.en.transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni

verses.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ الْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَامُهُم بِهَـٰذَا ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
translations.en.transliteration: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
translations.en.transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona

verses.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
translations.en.transliteration: Falyatoo bi<u>h</u>adeethin mithlihi in k<u>a</u>noo <u>sa</u>diqeena

verses.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ الْخَالِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
translations.en.transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
translations.en.transliteration: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ الْمُصَيْطِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
translations.en.transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
translations.en.transliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ الْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ الْبَنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
translations.en.transliteration: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
translations.en.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
translations.en.transliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

verses.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا هُمُ الْمَكِيدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
translations.en.transliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
translations.en.transliteration: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا كِسْفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
translations.en.transliteration: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
translations.en.transliteration: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ

translations.en.sahih: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
translations.en.transliteration: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ النُّجُومِ

translations.en.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi

verses.arabic: وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: By the star when it descends,
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnajmi itha hawa

verses.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> <u>d</u>alla <u>sah</u>ibukum wam<u>a</u> ghaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> yan<u>t</u>iqu AAani alhaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: It is not but a revelation revealed,
translations.en.transliteration: In huwa ill<u>a</u> wa<u>h</u>yun yoo<u>ha</u>

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
translations.en.transliteration: AAallamahu shadeedu alquw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
translations.en.transliteration: Thoo mirratin faistawa

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then he approached and descended
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma dan<u>a</u> fatadall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
translations.en.transliteration: Fak<u>a</u>na q<u>a</u>ba qawsayni aw adn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaw<u>ha</u> il<u>a</u> AAabdihi m<u>a</u> aw<u>ha</u>

verses.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> ka<u>th</u>aba alfu<u>a</u>du m<u>a</u> ra<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
translations.en.transliteration: Afatum<u>a</u>roonahu AAal<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> yar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he certainly saw him in another descent
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad ra<u>a</u>hu nazlatan okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
translations.en.transliteration: AAinda sidrati almuntah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
translations.en.transliteration: AAindah<u>a</u> jannatu almaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
translations.en.transliteration: Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha

verses.arabic: مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> z<u>a</u>gha alba<u>s</u>aru wam<u>a</u> <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad ra<u>a</u> min <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>ti rabbihi alkubr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza

verses.arabic: وَمَنَاةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And Manat, the third - the other one?
translations.en.transliteration: Wamanata alththalithata alokhra

verses.arabic: أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنثَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
translations.en.transliteration: Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: That, then, is an unjust division.
translations.en.transliteration: Tilka i<u>th</u>an qismatun <u>d</u>eez<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُم مَّا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
translations.en.transliteration: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda

verses.arabic: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
translations.en.transliteration: Am lilins<u>a</u>ni m<u>a</u> tamann<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ الْآخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
translations.en.transliteration: Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola

verses.arabic: وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنثَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا

translations.en.sahih: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan

verses.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

translations.en.sahih: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
translations.en.transliteration: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>Tha</u>lika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman <u>d</u>alla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtad<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى

translations.en.sahih: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
translations.en.transliteration: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who turned away
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraayta alla<u>th</u>ee tawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
translations.en.transliteration: WaaAA<u>ta</u> qaleelan waakd<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
translations.en.transliteration: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
translations.en.transliteration: Am lam yunabba bim<u>a</u> fee <u>s</u>u<u>h</u>ufi moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
translations.en.transliteration: Waibr<u>a</u>heema alla<u>th</u>ee waff<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
translations.en.transliteration: All<u>a</u> taziru w<u>a</u>ziratun wizra okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
translations.en.transliteration: Waan laysa lilins<u>a</u>ni ill<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> saAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that his effort is going to be seen -
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yur<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma yujz<u>a</u>hu aljaz<u>a</u>a alawf<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الْمُنتَهَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that to your Lord is the finality
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna il<u>a</u> rabbika almuntah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu huwa a<u>dh</u>aka waabk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu huwa am<u>a</u>ta waa<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

verses.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
translations.en.transliteration: Min nu<u>t</u>fatin i<u>tha</u> tumn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu huwa aghn<u>a</u> waaqn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu ahlaka AA<u>a</u>dan alool<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
translations.en.transliteration: Wathamooda fam<u>a</u> abq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha

verses.arabic: وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And the overturned towns He hurled down
translations.en.transliteration: Waalmutafikata ahwa

verses.arabic: فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And covered them by that which He covered.
translations.en.transliteration: Faghashsh<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> ghashsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi <u>a</u>l<u>a</u>i rabbika tatam<u>a</u>r<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola

verses.arabic: أَزِفَتِ الْآزِفَةُ

translations.en.sahih: The Approaching Day has approached.
translations.en.transliteration: Azifati alazifatu

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
translations.en.transliteration: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun

verses.arabic: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then at this statement do you wonder?
translations.en.transliteration: Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona

verses.arabic: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And you laugh and do not weep
translations.en.transliteration: Watadhakoona wala tabkoona

verses.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ سَامِدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: While you are proudly sporting?
translations.en.transliteration: Waantum samidoona

verses.arabic: فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ وَاعْبُدُوا ۩

translations.en.sahih: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
translations.en.transliteration: Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo

verses.arabic: اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ

translations.en.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
translations.en.transliteration: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا آيَةً يُعْرِضُوا وَيَقُولُوا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ

translations.en.sahih: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
translations.en.transliteration: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

translations.en.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُم مِّنَ الْأَنبَاءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

translations.en.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun

verses.arabic: حِكْمَةٌ بَالِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُ

translations.en.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
translations.en.transliteration: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍ

translations.en.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
translations.en.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin

verses.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
translations.en.transliteration: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun

verses.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى الدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
translations.en.transliteration: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا مَجْنُونٌ وَازْدُجِرَ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ

translations.en.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
translations.en.transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir

verses.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
translations.en.transliteration: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin

verses.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا الْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاءُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ

translations.en.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
translations.en.transliteration: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira

verses.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
translations.en.transliteration: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin

verses.arabic: تَجْرِي بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَاءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

translations.en.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
translations.en.transliteration: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَاهَا آيَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin

verses.arabic: تَنزِعُ النَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
translations.en.transliteration: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِالنُّذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: Thamud denied the warning
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّفِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin

verses.arabic: أَأُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
translations.en.transliteration: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun

verses.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْأَشِرُ

translations.en.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
translations.en.transliteration: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُو النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ الْمَاءَ قِسْمَةٌ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ

translations.en.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
translations.en.transliteration: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun

verses.arabic: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

translations.en.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
translations.en.transliteration: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّا آلَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَاهُم بِسَحَرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin

verses.arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي مَن شَكَرَ

translations.en.sahih: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
translations.en.transliteration: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِ فَطَمَسْنَا أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ

translations.en.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ

translations.en.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ

translations.en.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru

verses.arabic: كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَاهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin

verses.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُولَـٰئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ

translations.en.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
translations.en.transliteration: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
translations.en.transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun

verses.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ الدُّبُرَ

translations.en.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
translations.en.transliteration: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura

verses.arabic: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

translations.en.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
translations.en.transliteration: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَالٍ وَسُعُرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِي النَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَاهُ بِقَدَرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ

translations.en.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَا أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ

translations.en.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

translations.en.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَهَرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin

verses.arabic: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
translations.en.transliteration: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin

verses.arabic: الرَّحْمَـٰنُ

translations.en.sahih: The Most Merciful
translations.en.transliteration: Alrrahmanu

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ

translations.en.sahih: Taught the Qur'an,
translations.en.transliteration: AAallama alqurana

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ

translations.en.sahih: Created man,
translations.en.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ الْبَيَانَ

translations.en.sahih: [And] taught him eloquence.
translations.en.transliteration: AAallamahu albayana

verses.arabic: الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
translations.en.transliteration: Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin

verses.arabic: وَالنَّجْمُ وَالشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ

translations.en.sahih: And the stars and trees prostrate.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani

verses.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ الْمِيزَانَ

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا فِي الْمِيزَانِ

translations.en.sahih: That you not transgress within the balance.
translations.en.transliteration: Alla tatghaw fee almeezani

verses.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ

translations.en.sahih: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
translations.en.transliteration: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana

verses.arabic: وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ

translations.en.sahih: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami

verses.arabic: فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَالنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ الْأَكْمَامِ

translations.en.sahih: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
translations.en.transliteration: Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami

verses.arabic: وَالْحَبُّ ذُو الْعَصْفِ وَالرَّيْحَانُ

translations.en.sahih: And grain having husks and scented plants.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ

translations.en.sahih: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
translations.en.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

translations.en.sahih: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ الْمَغْرِبَيْنِ

translations.en.sahih: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ

translations.en.sahih: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
translations.en.transliteration: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani

verses.arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ

translations.en.sahih: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
translations.en.transliteration: Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

translations.en.sahih: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
translations.en.transliteration: Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi <u>a</u>l<u>a</u>i rabbikum<u>a</u> tuka<u>thth</u>ib<u>a</u>ni

verses.arabic: وَلَهُ الْجَوَارِ الْمُنشَآتُ فِي الْبَحْرِ كَالْأَعْلَامِ

translations.en.sahih: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
translations.en.transliteration: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
translations.en.transliteration: Kullu man AAalayha fanin

verses.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

translations.en.sahih: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ

translations.en.sahih: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
translations.en.transliteration: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ الثَّقَلَانِ

translations.en.sahih: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
translations.en.transliteration: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: يَا مَعْشَرَ الْجِنِّ وَالْإِنسِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا مِنْ أَقْطَارِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ فَانفُذُوا ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

translations.en.sahih: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
translations.en.transliteration: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ

translations.en.sahih: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْأَلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَانٌّ

translations.en.sahih: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
translations.en.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: يُعْرَفُ الْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَاهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِالنَّوَاصِي وَالْأَقْدَامِ

translations.en.sahih: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
translations.en.transliteration: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: هَـٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِي يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا الْمُجْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
translations.en.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona

verses.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ آنٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
translations.en.transliteration: Yatoofoona baynaha wabayna hameemin anin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ جَنَّتَانِ

translations.en.sahih: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
translations.en.transliteration: Waliman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: ذَوَاتَا أَفْنَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: Having [spreading] branches.
translations.en.transliteration: Thawata afnanin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
translations.en.transliteration: Feehima AAaynani tajriyani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
translations.en.transliteration: Feehima min kulli fakihatin zawjani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ

translations.en.sahih: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
translations.en.transliteration: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ الْيَاقُوتُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ

translations.en.sahih: As if they were rubies and coral.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaannahunna alyaqootu waalmarjanu

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ

translations.en.sahih: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal jazao alihsani illa alihsanu

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ

translations.en.sahih: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin doonihima jannatani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: مُدْهَامَّتَانِ

translations.en.sahih: Dark green [in color].
translations.en.transliteration: Mudhammatani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
translations.en.transliteration: Feehima AAaynani naddakhatani

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ

translations.en.sahih: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
translations.en.transliteration: Feehima fakihatun wanakhlun warummanun

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ

translations.en.sahih: In them are good and beautiful women -
translations.en.transliteration: Feehinna khayratun hisanun

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ

translations.en.sahih: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
translations.en.transliteration: Hoorun maqsooratun fee alkhiyami

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ

translations.en.sahih: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
translations.en.transliteration: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانٍ

translations.en.sahih: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ

translations.en.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

verses.arabic: تَبَارَكَ اسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ

translations.en.sahih: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
translations.en.transliteration: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami

verses.arabic: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,
translations.en.transliteration: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
translations.en.transliteration: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathibatun

verses.arabic: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
translations.en.transliteration: Khafidatun rafiAAatun

verses.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا

translations.en.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
translations.en.transliteration: Itha rujjati alardu rajjan

verses.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
translations.en.transliteration: Wabussati aljibalu bassan

verses.arabic: فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُّنبَثًّا

translations.en.sahih: And become dust dispersing.
translations.en.transliteration: Fakanat habaan munbaththan

verses.arabic: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَاجًا ثَلَاثَةً

translations.en.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:
translations.en.transliteration: Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan

verses.arabic: فَأَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
translations.en.transliteration: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
translations.en.transliteration: Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati

verses.arabic: وَالسَّابِقُونَ السَّابِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika almuqarraboona

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples
translations.en.transliteration: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaleelun mina al<u>a</u>khireena

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],
translations.en.transliteration: AAala sururin mawdoonatin

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena AAalayha mutaqabileena

verses.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
translations.en.transliteration: Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona

verses.arabic: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
translations.en.transliteration: Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin

verses.arabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
translations.en.transliteration: La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona

verses.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And fruit of what they select
translations.en.transliteration: Wafakihatin mimma yatakhayyaroona

verses.arabic: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
translations.en.transliteration: Walahmi tayrin mimma yashtahoona

verses.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
translations.en.transliteration: Wahoorun AAeenun

verses.arabic: كَأَمْثَالِ اللُّؤْلُؤِ الْمَكْنُونِ

translations.en.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
translations.en.transliteration: Kaamthali allului almaknooni

verses.arabic: جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

verses.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
translations.en.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman

verses.arabic: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَامًا سَلَامًا

translations.en.sahih: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
translations.en.transliteration: Illa qeelan salaman salaman

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
translations.en.transliteration: Waashabu alyameeni ma ashabu alyameeni

verses.arabic: فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
translations.en.transliteration: Fee sidrin makhdoodin

verses.arabic: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
translations.en.transliteration: Watalhin mandoodin

verses.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ

translations.en.sahih: And shade extended
translations.en.transliteration: Wathillin mamdoodin

verses.arabic: وَمَاءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ

translations.en.sahih: And water poured out
translations.en.transliteration: Wamain maskoobin

verses.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
translations.en.transliteration: Wafakihatin katheeratin

verses.arabic: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
translations.en.transliteration: La maqtooAAatin wala mamnooAAatin

verses.arabic: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.
translations.en.transliteration: Wafurushin marfooAAatin

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنشَأْنَاهُنَّ إِنشَاءً

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
translations.en.transliteration: Inna anshanahunna inshaan

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا

translations.en.sahih: And made them virgins,
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAalnahunna abkaran

verses.arabic: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا

translations.en.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
translations.en.transliteration: AAuruban atraban

verses.arabic: لِّأَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]
translations.en.transliteration: Liashabi alyameeni

verses.arabic: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: A company of the former peoples
translations.en.transliteration: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

verses.arabic: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.
translations.en.transliteration: Wathullatun mina alakhireena

verses.arabic: وَأَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ مَا أَصْحَابُ الشِّمَالِ

translations.en.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
translations.en.transliteration: Waashabu alshshimali ma ashabu alshshimali

verses.arabic: فِي سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
translations.en.transliteration: Fee samoomin wahameemin

verses.arabic: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,
translations.en.transliteration: Wathillin min yahmoomin

verses.arabic: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.
translations.en.transliteration: La baridin wala kareemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum kanoo qabla thalika mutrafeena

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنثِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,
translations.en.transliteration: Wakanoo yusirroona AAala alhinthi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَكَانُوا يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَامًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
translations.en.transliteration: Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

verses.arabic: أَوَآبَاؤُنَا الْأَوَّلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Awa abaona alawwaloona

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
translations.en.transliteration: Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena

verses.arabic: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَاتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
translations.en.transliteration: LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا الضَّالُّونَ الْمُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona

verses.arabic: لَآكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ

translations.en.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
translations.en.transliteration: Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin

verses.arabic: فَمَالِئُونَ مِنْهَا الْبُطُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And filling with it your bellies
translations.en.transliteration: Famalioona minha albutoona

verses.arabic: فَشَارِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْحَمِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
translations.en.transliteration: Fashariboona AAalayhi mina alhameemi

verses.arabic: فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
translations.en.transliteration: Fashariboona shurba alheemi

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَاكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
translations.en.transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen that which you emit?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraaytum ma tumnoona

verses.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْخَالِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
translations.en.transliteration: Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ الْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
translations.en.transliteration: Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَالَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِي مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraaytum ma tahruthoona

verses.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُ أَمْ نَحْنُ الزَّارِعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
translations.en.transliteration: Aantum tazraAAoonahu am nahnu alzzariAAoona

verses.arabic: لَوْ نَشَاءُ لَجَعَلْنَاهُ حُطَامًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
translations.en.transliteration: Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
translations.en.transliteration: Inna lamughramoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
translations.en.transliteration: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ الْمَاءَ الَّذِي تَشْرَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen the water that you drink?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraaytumu almaa allathee tashraboona

verses.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ الْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنزِلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
translations.en.transliteration: Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona

verses.arabic: لَوْ نَشَاءُ جَعَلْنَاهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
translations.en.transliteration: Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona

verses.arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ النَّارَ الَّتِي تُورُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaraaytumu alnnara allatee tooroona

verses.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَا أَمْ نَحْنُ الْمُنشِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
translations.en.transliteration: Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona

verses.arabic: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَاهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَاعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ

translations.en.sahih: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
translations.en.transliteration: Nahnu jaAAalnaha tathkiratan wamataAAan lilmuqweena

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَاقِعِ النُّجُومِ

translations.en.sahih: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
translations.en.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bimawaqiAAi alnnujoomi

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu laqasamun law taAAlamoona AAatheemun

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu laquranun kareemun

verses.arabic: فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: In a Register well-protected;
translations.en.transliteration: Fee kitabin maknoonin

verses.arabic: لَّا يَمَسُّهُ إِلَّا الْمُطَهَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: None touch it except the purified.
translations.en.transliteration: La yamassuhu illa almutahharoona

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: أَفَبِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
translations.en.transliteration: Afabihatha alhadeethi antum mudhinoona

verses.arabic: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
translations.en.transliteration: WatajAAaloona rizqakum annakum tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ الْحُلْقُومَ

translations.en.sahih: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
translations.en.transliteration: Falawla itha balaghati alhulqooma

verses.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And you are at that time looking on -
translations.en.transliteration: Waantum heenaithin tanthuroona

verses.arabic: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
translations.en.transliteration: Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona

verses.arabic: فَلَوْلَا إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
translations.en.transliteration: Falawla in kuntum ghayra madeeneena

verses.arabic: تَرْجِعُونَهَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
translations.en.transliteration: TarjiAAoonaha in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma in kana mina almuqarrabeena

verses.arabic: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: Farawhun warayhanun wajannatu naAAeemin

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And if he was of the companions of the right,
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni

verses.arabic: فَسَلَامٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
translations.en.transliteration: Fasalamun laka min ashabi alyameeni

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِن كَانَ مِنَ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ الضَّالِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena

verses.arabic: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
translations.en.transliteration: Fanuzulun min hameemin

verses.arabic: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And burning in Hellfire
translations.en.transliteration: Watasliyatu jaheemin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ الْيَقِينِ
