verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ فَقَالُوا أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا وَتَوَلَّوا ۚ وَّاسْتَغْنَى اللَّهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
translations.en.transliteration: Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw waistaghna Allahu waAllahu ghaniyyun hameedun

verses.arabic: زَعَمَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّي لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah, is easy."
translations.en.transliteration: ZaAAama allatheena kafaroo an lan yubAAathoo qul bala warabbee latubAAathunna thumma latunabbaonna bima AAamiltum wathalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

verses.arabic: فَآمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَالنُّورِ الَّذِي أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalnnoori allathee anzalna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ الْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ التَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yajmaAAukum liyawmi aljamAAi thalika yawmu alttaghabuni waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ النَّارِ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseeru

verses.arabic: مَا أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah. And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin biAllahi yahdi qalbahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا الرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا الْبَلَاغُ الْمُبِينُ

translations.en.sahih: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
translations.en.transliteration: WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَادِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا وَتَصْفَحُوا وَتَغْفِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum AAaduwwan lakum faihtharoohum wain taAAfoo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
translations.en.transliteration: Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waAllahu AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun

verses.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُوا وَأَطِيعُوا وَأَنفِقُوا خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
translations.en.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha ma istataAAtum waismaAAoo waateeAAoo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona

verses.arabic: إِن تُقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَاعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.
translations.en.transliteration: In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu shakoorun haleemun

verses.arabic: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alAAazeezu alhakeemu

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُوا الْعِدَّةَ ۖ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ ۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِن بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّا أَن يَأْتِينَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَقَدْ ظَلَمَ نَفْسَهُ ۚ لَا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرًا

translations.en.sahih: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fatalliqoohunna liAAiddatihinna waahsoo alAAiddata waittaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faqad thalama nafsahu la tadree laAAalla Allaha yuhdithu baAAda thalika amran

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا

translations.en.sahih: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw fariqoohunna bimaAAroofin waashhidoo thaway AAadlin minkum waaqeemoo alshshahadata lillahi thalikum yooAAathu bihi man kana yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu makhrajan

verses.arabic: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran

verses.arabic: وَاللَّائِي يَئِسْنَ مِنَ الْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَائِكُمْ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَاللَّائِي لَمْ يَحِضْنَ ۚ وَأُولَاتُ الْأَحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ يُسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum faAAiddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin waallaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yadaAAna hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu min amrihi yusran

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّئَاتِهِ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُ أَجْرًا

translations.en.sahih: That is the command of Allah, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
translations.en.transliteration: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran

verses.arabic: أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.
translations.en.transliteration: Askinoohunna min <u>h</u>aythu sakantum min wujdikum wal<u>a</u> tu<u>da</u>rroohunna litu<u>d</u>ayyiqoo AAalayhinna wain kunna ol<u>a</u>ti <u>h</u>amlin faanfiqoo AAalayhinna <u>h</u>att<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>aAAna <u>h</u>amlahunna fain ar<u>d</u>aAAna lakum fa<u>a</u>toohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bimaAAroofin wain taAA<u>a</u>sartum fasatur<u>d</u>iAAu lahu okhr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Liyunfiq thoo saAAatin min saAAatihi waman qudira AAalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa ma ataha sayajAAalu Allahu baAAda AAusrin yusran

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِ فَحَاسَبْنَاهَا حِسَابًا شَدِيدًا وَعَذَّبْنَاهَا عَذَابًا نُّكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakaayyin min qaryatin AAatat AAan amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnaha hisaban shadeedan waAAaththabnaha AAathaban nukran

verses.arabic: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَا وَكَانَ عَاقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss.
translations.en.transliteration: Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana AAaqibatu amriha khusran

verses.arabic: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَا أُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ قَدْ أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah, O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.
translations.en.transliteration: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikran

verses.arabic: رَّسُولًا يَتْلُو عَلَيْكُمْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنَاتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ ۚ وَمَن يُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ قَدْ أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزْقًا

translations.en.sahih: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision.
translations.en.transliteration: Rasoolan yatloo AAalaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqan

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ وَمِنَ الْأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الْأَمْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عِلْمًا

translations.en.sahih: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ ۖ تَبْتَغِي مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَاجِكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

verses.arabic: قَدْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَانِكُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ

translations.en.sahih: Allah has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum waAllahu mawlakum wahuwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُ وَأَعْرَضَ عَن بَعْضٍ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنبَأَكَ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ الْعَلِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted."
translations.en.transliteration: Waith asarra alnnabiyyu ila baAAdi azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waathharahu Allahu AAalayhi AAarrafa baAAdahu waaAArada AAan baAAdin falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya alAAaleemu alkhabeeru

verses.arabic: إِن تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَا ۖ وَإِن تَظَاهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَوْلَاهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَالِحُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: If you two [wives] repent to Allah, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
translations.en.transliteration: In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain tathahara AAalayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena waalmalaikatu baAAda thalika thaheerun

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُّؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
translations.en.transliteration: AAasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin AAabidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkaran

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَارًا وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَائِكَةٌ غِلَاظٌ شِدَادٌ لَّا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَا أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu AAalayha malaikatun ghilathun shidadun la yaAAsoona Allaha ma amarahum wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا الْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la taAAtathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِي اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ ۖ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَىٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan AAasa rabbukum an yukaffira AAankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu alnnabiyya waallatheena amanoo maAAahu nooruhum yasAAa bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana waighfir lana innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ جَاهِدِ الْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَافِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru

verses.arabic: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا امْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا وَقِيلَ ادْخُلَا النَّارَ مَعَ الدَّاخِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
translations.en.transliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin waimraata lootin kanata tahta AAabdayni min AAibadina salihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya AAanhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula alnnara maAAa alddakhileena

verses.arabic: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا امْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
translations.en.transliteration: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata firAAawna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee AAindaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min firAAawna waAAamalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamaryama ibnata AAimrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteena

verses.arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
translations.en.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَاةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ

translations.en.sahih: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَاهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَاطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
translations.en.transliteration: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru

verses.arabic: إِذَا أُلْقُوا فِيهَا سَمِعُوا لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِيَ تَفُورُ

translations.en.sahih: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
translations.en.transliteration: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru

verses.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَا أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
translations.en.transliteration: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun

verses.arabic: قَالُوا بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَاءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَالٍ كَبِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِي أَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri

verses.arabic: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَابِ السَّعِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
translations.en.transliteration: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun

verses.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
translations.en.transliteration: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

verses.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
translations.en.transliteration: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru

verses.arabic: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ

translations.en.sahih: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
translations.en.transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru

verses.arabic: أَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ

translations.en.sahih: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
translations.en.transliteration: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru

verses.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِي السَّمَاءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
translations.en.transliteration: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ

translations.en.sahih: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
translations.en.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ الْكَافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
translations.en.transliteration: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin

verses.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ

translations.en.sahih: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
translations.en.transliteration: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin

verses.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَىٰ أَمَّن يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
translations.en.transliteration: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصَارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

verses.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
translations.en.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيئَتْ وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ الْكَافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَاءٍ مَّعِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
translations.en.transliteration: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin

verses.arabic: ن ۚ وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,
translations.en.transliteration: Noon waalqalami wama yasturoona

verses.arabic: مَا أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma anta biniAAmati rabbika bimajnoonin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna laka laajran ghayra mamnoonin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnaka laAAala khuluqin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So you will see and they will see
translations.en.transliteration: Fasatubsiru wayubsiroona

verses.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ الْمَفْتُونُ

translations.en.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
translations.en.transliteration: Biayyikumu almaftoonu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

verses.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ الْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeena

verses.arabic: وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
translations.en.transliteration: Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tutiAA kulla hallafin maheenin

verses.arabic: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
translations.en.transliteration: Hammazin mashshain binameemin

verses.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
translations.en.transliteration: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheemin

verses.arabic: عُتُلٍّ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
translations.en.transliteration: AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneemin

verses.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
translations.en.transliteration: An kana tha malin wabaneena

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.en.transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

verses.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ

translations.en.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.
translations.en.transliteration: Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoomi

verses.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
translations.en.transliteration: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Without making exception.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yastathnoona

verses.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona

verses.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: And it became as though reaped.
translations.en.transliteration: Faasbahat kaalssareemi

verses.arabic: فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they called one another at morning,
translations.en.transliteration: Fatanadaw musbiheena

verses.arabic: أَنِ اغْدُوا عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَارِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
translations.en.transliteration: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena

verses.arabic: فَانطَلَقُوا وَهُمْ يَتَخَافَتُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
translations.en.transliteration: Faintalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoona

verses.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
translations.en.transliteration: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun

verses.arabic: وَغَدَوْا عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَادِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
translations.en.transliteration: Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireena

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوا إِنَّا لَضَالُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
translations.en.transliteration: Falamma raawha qaloo inna ladalloona

verses.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
translations.en.transliteration: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
translations.en.transliteration: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena

verses.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatalawamoona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena

verses.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَا أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
translations.en.transliteration: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَالْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
translations.en.transliteration: AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kaalmujrimeena

verses.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَابٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
translations.en.transliteration: Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
translations.en.transliteration: Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
translations.en.transliteration: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona

verses.arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
translations.en.transliteration: Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeemun

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
translations.en.transliteration: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona

verses.arabic: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
translations.en.transliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona

verses.arabic: فَذَرْنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
translations.en.transliteration: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
translations.en.transliteration: Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
translations.en.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

verses.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ الْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
translations.en.transliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
translations.en.transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun

verses.arabic: لَّوْلَا أَن تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
translations.en.transliteration: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun

verses.arabic: فَاجْتَبَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَجَعَلَهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Faijtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahu mina alssaliheena

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
translations.en.transliteration: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: الْحَاقَّةُ

translations.en.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -
translations.en.transliteration: Alhaqqatu

verses.arabic: مَا الْحَاقَّةُ

translations.en.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?
translations.en.transliteration: Ma alhaqqatu

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alhaqqatu

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌ بِالْقَارِعَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bialqariAAati

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِالطَّاغِيَةِ

translations.en.sahih: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bialttaghiyati

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin

verses.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
translations.en.transliteration: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun

verses.arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّن بَاقِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?
translations.en.transliteration: Fahal tara lahum min baqiyatin

verses.arabic: وَجَاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُ وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَاتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati

verses.arabic: فَعَصَوْا رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

translations.en.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
translations.en.transliteration: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan

verses.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْمَاءُ حَمَلْنَاكُمْ فِي الْجَارِيَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
translations.en.transliteration: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

verses.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
translations.en.transliteration: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun

verses.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَاحِدَةً

translations.en.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
translations.en.transliteration: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ الْوَاقِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
translations.en.transliteration: Fayawmaithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

verses.arabic: وَانشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَهِيَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainshaqqati alssamao fahiya yawmaithin wahiyatun

verses.arabic: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰ أَرْجَائِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَانِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
translations.en.transliteration: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
translations.en.transliteration: Faamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu h<u>a</u>omu iqraoo kit<u>a</u>biyah

verses.arabic: إِنِّي ظَنَنتُ أَنِّي مُلَاقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
translations.en.transliteration: Innee thanantu annee mulaqin hisabiyah

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -
translations.en.transliteration: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: In an elevated garden,
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

verses.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
translations.en.transliteration: Qutoofuha daniyatun

verses.arabic: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي الْأَيَّامِ الْخَالِيَةِ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِشِمَالِهِ فَيَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَابِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
translations.en.transliteration: Waamm<u>a</u> man ootiya kit<u>a</u>bahu bishim<u>a</u>lihi fayaqoolu y<u>a</u> laytanee lam oota kit<u>a</u>biyah

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: And had not known what is my account.
translations.en.transliteration: Walam adri m<u>a</u> <u>h</u>is<u>a</u>biyah

verses.arabic: يَا لَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ الْقَاضِيَةَ

translations.en.sahih: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya laytaha kanati alqadiyatu

verses.arabic: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّي مَالِيَهْ ۜ

translations.en.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> aghn<u>a</u> AAannee m<u>a</u>liyah

verses.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلْطَانِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."
translations.en.transliteration: Halaka AAannee sul<u>ta</u>niyah

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ

translations.en.sahih: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
translations.en.transliteration: Khuthoohu faghulloohu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma aljaheema salloohu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

verses.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ الْيَوْمَ هَاهُنَا حَمِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
translations.en.transliteration: Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameemun

verses.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
translations.en.transliteration: Wala taAAamun illa min ghisleenin

verses.arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُ إِلَّا الْخَاطِئُونَ

translations.en.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.
translations.en.transliteration: La yakuluhu illa alkhatioona

verses.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by what you see
translations.en.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroona

verses.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And what you do not see
translations.en.transliteration: Wama la tubsiroona

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ الْأَقَاوِيلِ

translations.en.sahih: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAda alaqaweeli

verses.arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِالْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;
translations.en.transliteration: Laakhathna minhu bialyameeni

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ الْوَتِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma laqataAAna minhu alwateena

verses.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
translations.en.transliteration: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu lahasratun AAala alkafireena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَحَقُّ الْيَقِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu lahaqqu alyaqeeni

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ

translations.en.sahih: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
translations.en.transliteration: Saala sailun biAAathabin waqiAAin

verses.arabic: لِّلْكَافِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُ دَافِعٌ

translations.en.sahih: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
translations.en.transliteration: Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAAun

verses.arabic: مِّنَ اللَّهِ ذِي الْمَعَارِجِ

translations.en.sahih: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
translations.en.transliteration: Mina Allahi thee almaAAariji

verses.arabic: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
translations.en.transliteration: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: So be patient with gracious patience.
translations.en.transliteration: Faisbir sabran jameelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيدًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum yarawnahu baAAeedan

verses.arabic: وَنَرَاهُ قَرِيبًا

translations.en.sahih: But We see it [as] near.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanarahu qareeban

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ السَّمَاءُ كَالْمُهْلِ

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma takoonu alssamao kaalmuhli

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool,
translations.en.transliteration: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَسْأَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yasalu hameemun hameeman

verses.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ بِبَنِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
translations.en.transliteration: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi

verses.arabic: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: And his wife and his brother
translations.en.transliteration: Wasahibatihi waakheehi

verses.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُؤْوِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
translations.en.transliteration: Wafaseelatihi allatee tuweehi

verses.arabic: وَمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla innaha latha

verses.arabic: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: A remover of exteriors.
translations.en.transliteration: NazzaAAatan lilshshawa

verses.arabic: تَدْعُو مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
translations.en.transliteration: TadAAoo man adbara watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
translations.en.transliteration: WajamaAAa faawAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alinsana khuliqa halooAAan

verses.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا

translations.en.sahih: When evil touches him, impatient,
translations.en.transliteration: Itha massahu alshsharru jazooAAan

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا

translations.en.sahih: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha massahu alkhayru manooAAan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الْمُصَلِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except the observers of prayer -
translations.en.transliteration: Illa almusalleena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَائِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those who are constant in their prayer
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena hum AAala salatihim daimoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ فِي أَمْوَالِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: And those within whose wealth is a known right
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena fee amwalihim haqqun maAAloomun

verses.arabic: لِّلسَّائِلِ وَالْمَحْرُومِ

translations.en.sahih: For the petitioner and the deprived -
translations.en.transliteration: Lilssaili waalmahroomi

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena yusaddiqoona biyawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru mamoonin

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who guard their private parts
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰ أَزْوَاجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
translations.en.transliteration: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ابْتَغَىٰ وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْعَادُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
translations.en.transliteration: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who are in their testimonies upright
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena hum bishahadatihim qaimoona

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena hum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They will be in gardens, honored.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika fee jannatin mukramoona

verses.arabic: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
translations.en.transliteration: Famali allatheena kafaroo qibalaka muhtiAAeena

verses.arabic: عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
translations.en.transliteration: AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali AAizeena

verses.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
translations.en.transliteration: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشَارِقِ وَالْمَغَارِبِ إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
translations.en.transliteration: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ

translations.en.sahih: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا وَيَلْعَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يُلَاقُوا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
translations.en.transliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

verses.arabic: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَانُوا يُوعَدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
translations.en.transliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.en.sahih: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
translations.en.transliteration: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun

verses.arabic: أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
translations.en.transliteration: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni

verses.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذَا جَاءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
translations.en.transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan

verses.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَائِي إِلَّا فِرَارًا

translations.en.sahih: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
translations.en.transliteration: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوا أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْا ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا اسْتِكْبَارًا

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا

translations.en.sahih: Then I invited them publicly.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا

translations.en.sahih: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran

verses.arabic: فَقُلْتُ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّارًا

translations.en.sahih: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran

verses.arabic: يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا

translations.en.sahih: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
translations.en.transliteration: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran

verses.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَارًا

translations.en.sahih: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan

verses.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا

translations.en.sahih: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
translations.en.transliteration: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا

translations.en.sahih: While He has created you in stages?
translations.en.transliteration: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا

translations.en.sahih: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
translations.en.transliteration: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلَ الْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِّنَ الْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا

translations.en.sahih: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan

verses.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
translations.en.transliteration: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan

verses.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَاتَّبَعُوا مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلَّا خَسَارًا

translations.en.sahih: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
translations.en.transliteration: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا

translations.en.sahih: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا لَا تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَالًا

translations.en.sahih: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
translations.en.transliteration: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan

verses.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا فَأُدْخِلُوا نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اللَّهِ أَنصَارًا

translations.en.sahih: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
translations.en.transliteration: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا

translations.en.sahih: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
translations.en.transliteration: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
translations.en.transliteration: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran

verses.arabic: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَقَالُوا إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآنًا عَجَبًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

verses.arabic: يَهْدِي إِلَى الرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا أَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
translations.en.transliteration: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا

translations.en.sahih: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن تَقُولَ الْإِنسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا

translations.en.sahih: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا

translations.en.sahih: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا

translations.en.sahih: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ الْآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِي أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
