translations.en.transliteration: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَائِقَ قِدَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّا أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اللَّهَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَبًا

translations.en.sahih: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا الْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا

translations.en.sahih: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا

translations.en.sahih: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
translations.en.transliteration: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا

translations.en.sahih: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
translations.en.transliteration: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

verses.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا

translations.en.sahih: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّ الْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
translations.en.transliteration: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا

translations.en.sahih: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
translations.en.transliteration: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَدْعُو رَبِّي وَلَا أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لَا أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
translations.en.transliteration: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَاغًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسَالَاتِهِ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا

translations.en.sahih: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْا مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا

translations.en.sahih: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِي أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّي أَمَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
translations.en.transliteration: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

verses.arabic: عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا

translations.en.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
translations.en.transliteration: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَدًا

translations.en.sahih: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
translations.en.transliteration: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

verses.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَدًا

translations.en.sahih: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
translations.en.transliteration: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ

translations.en.sahih: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu

verses.arabic: قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
translations.en.transliteration: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan

verses.arabic: نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ انقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
translations.en.transliteration: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan

verses.arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
translations.en.transliteration: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِي عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اللَّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْئًا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan

verses.arabic: رَّبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

verses.arabic: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
translations.en.transliteration: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan

verses.arabic: وَذَرْنِي وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
translations.en.transliteration: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَا أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
translations.en.transliteration: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman

verses.arabic: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
translations.en.transliteration: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan

verses.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَاهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
translations.en.transliteration: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيبًا

translations.en.sahih: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
translations.en.transliteration: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban

verses.arabic: السَّمَاءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُ مَفْعُولًا

translations.en.sahih: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
translations.en.transliteration: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْمُدَّثِّرُ

translations.en.sahih: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha almuddaththiru

verses.arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ

translations.en.sahih: Arise and warn
translations.en.transliteration: Qum faan<u>th</u>ir

verses.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord glorify
translations.en.transliteration: Warabbaka fakabbir

verses.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ

translations.en.sahih: And your clothing purify
translations.en.transliteration: Wathiy<u>a</u>baka fa<u>t</u>ahhir

verses.arabic: وَالرُّجْزَ فَاهْجُرْ

translations.en.sahih: And uncleanliness avoid
translations.en.transliteration: Waalrrujza faohjur

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ

translations.en.sahih: And do not confer favor to acquire more
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tamnun tastakthiru

verses.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَاصْبِرْ

translations.en.sahih: But for your Lord be patient.
translations.en.transliteration: Walirabbika faisbir

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي النَّاقُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And when the trumpet is blown,
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha nuqira fee alnnaqoori

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: That Day will be a difficult day
translations.en.transliteration: Fathalika yawmaithin yawmun AAaseerun

verses.arabic: عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ

translations.en.sahih: For the disbelievers - not easy.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala alkafireena ghayru yaseerin

verses.arabic: ذَرْنِي وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا

translations.en.sahih: Leave Me with the one I created alone
translations.en.transliteration: Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheedan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا

translations.en.sahih: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdoodan

verses.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا

translations.en.sahih: And children present [with him]
translations.en.transliteration: Wabaneena shuhoodan

verses.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا

translations.en.sahih: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
translations.en.transliteration: Wamahhadtu lahu tamheedan

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ

translations.en.sahih: Then he desires that I should add more.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma yatmaAAu an azeeda

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِآيَاتِنَا عَنِيدًا

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla innahu kana liayatina AAaneedan

verses.arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُ صَعُودًا

translations.en.sahih: I will cover him with arduous torment.
translations.en.transliteration: Saorhiquhu saAAoodan

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu fakkara waqaddara

verses.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

translations.en.sahih: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqutila kayfa qaddara

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ

translations.en.sahih: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma qutila kayfa qaddara

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Then he considered [again];
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma nathara

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Then he frowned and scowled;
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma AAabasa wabasara

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned back and was arrogant
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma adbara waistakbara

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ

translations.en.sahih: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
translations.en.transliteration: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu

verses.arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلَّا قَوْلُ الْبَشَرِ

translations.en.sahih: This is not but the word of a human being."
translations.en.transliteration: In hatha illa qawlu albashari

verses.arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ

translations.en.sahih: I will drive him into Saqar.
translations.en.transliteration: Saosleehi saqara

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سَقَرُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma saqaru

verses.arabic: لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ

translations.en.sahih: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
translations.en.transliteration: La tubqee wala tatharu

verses.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ

translations.en.sahih: Blackening the skins.
translations.en.transliteration: Lawwahatun lilbashari

verses.arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Over it are nineteen [angels].
translations.en.transliteration: AAalayha tisAAata AAashara

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَائِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَيَزْدَادَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِيمَانًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْكَافِرُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ

translations.en.sahih: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari

verses.arabic: كَلَّا وَالْقَمَرِ

translations.en.sahih: No! By the moon
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla waalqamari

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it departs
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli ith adbara

verses.arabic: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا أَسْفَرَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssubhi itha asfara

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى الْكُبَرِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
translations.en.transliteration: Innaha laihda alkubari

verses.arabic: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ

translations.en.sahih: As a warning to humanity -
translations.en.transliteration: Natheeran lilbashari

verses.arabic: لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ

translations.en.sahih: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
translations.en.transliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara

verses.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
translations.en.transliteration: Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenatun

verses.arabic: إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ الْيَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Except the companions of the right,
translations.en.transliteration: Illa ashaba alyameeni

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannatin yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: About the criminals,
translations.en.transliteration: AAani almujrimeena

verses.arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ

translations.en.sahih: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
translations.en.transliteration: Ma salakakum fee saqara

verses.arabic: قَالُوا لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ الْمُصَلِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo lam naku mina almusalleena

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ الْمِسْكِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
translations.en.transliteration: Walam naku nutAAimu almiskeena

verses.arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ الْخَائِضِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
translations.en.transliteration: Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkhaideena

verses.arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
translations.en.transliteration: Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَتَانَا الْيَقِينُ

translations.en.sahih: Until there came to us the certainty."
translations.en.transliteration: Hatta atana alyaqeenu

verses.arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَاعَةُ الشَّافِعِينَ

translations.en.sahih: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
translations.en.transliteration: Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu alshshafiAAeena

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ التَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
translations.en.transliteration: Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: As if they were alarmed donkeys
translations.en.transliteration: Kaannahum humurun mustanfiratun

verses.arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Fleeing from a lion?
translations.en.transliteration: Farrat min qaswaratin

verses.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً

translations.en.sahih: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ الْآخِرَةَ

translations.en.sahih: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla bal la yakhafoona alakhirata

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla innahu tathkiratun

verses.arabic: فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then whoever wills will remember it.
translations.en.transliteration: Faman shaa thakarahu

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ التَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati

verses.arabic: لَا أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ

translations.en.sahih: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
translations.en.transliteration: La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamati

verses.arabic: وَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالنَّفْسِ اللَّوَّامَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
translations.en.transliteration: Wala oqsimu bialnnafsi allawwamati

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
translations.en.transliteration: Ayahsabu alinsanu allan najmaAAa AAithamahu

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَادِرِينَ عَلَىٰ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
translations.en.transliteration: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu

verses.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ الْإِنسَانُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُ

translations.en.sahih: But man desires to continue in sin.
translations.en.transliteration: Bal yureedu alinsanu liyafjura amamahu

verses.arabic: يَسْأَلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ

translations.en.sahih: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
translations.en.transliteration: Yasalu ayyana yawmu alqiyamati

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ

translations.en.sahih: So when vision is dazzled
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha bariqa albasaru

verses.arabic: وَخَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ

translations.en.sahih: And the moon darkens
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhasafa alqamaru

verses.arabic: وَجُمِعَ الشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ

translations.en.sahih: And the sun and the moon are joined,
translations.en.transliteration: WajumiAAa alshshamsu waalqamaru

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ الْمَفَرُّ

translations.en.sahih: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
translations.en.transliteration: Yaqoolu alinsanu yawmaithin ayna almafarru

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ

translations.en.sahih: No! There is no refuge.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla la wazara

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُسْتَقَرُّ

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
translations.en.transliteration: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almustaqarru

verses.arabic: يُنَبَّأُ الْإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

translations.en.sahih: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
translations.en.transliteration: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara

verses.arabic: بَلِ الْإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
translations.en.transliteration: Bali alinsanu AAala nafsihi baseeratun

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Even if he presents his excuses.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaw alqa maAAatheerahu

verses.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ

translations.en.sahih: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
translations.en.transliteration: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waquranahu

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَاتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ

translations.en.sahih: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha qaranahu faittabiAA quranahu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma inna AAalayna bayanahu

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ

translations.en.sahih: No! But you love the immediate
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajilata

verses.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ الْآخِرَةَ

translations.en.sahih: And leave the Hereafter.
translations.en.transliteration: Watatharoona alakhirata

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
translations.en.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin nadiratun

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Looking at their Lord.
translations.en.transliteration: Ila rabbiha nathiratun

verses.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
translations.en.transliteration: Wawujoohun yawmaithin basiratun

verses.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
translations.en.transliteration: Tathunnu an yufAAala biha faqiratun

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِذَا بَلَغَتِ التَّرَاقِيَ

translations.en.sahih: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla itha balaghati alttaraqiya

verses.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ

translations.en.sahih: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
translations.en.transliteration: Waqeela man raqin

verses.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ الْفِرَاقُ

translations.en.sahih: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
translations.en.transliteration: Wathanna annahu alfiraqu

verses.arabic: وَالْتَفَّتِ السَّاقُ بِالسَّاقِ

translations.en.sahih: And the leg is wound about the leg,
translations.en.transliteration: Wailtaffati alssaqu bialssaqi

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمَسَاقُ

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
translations.en.transliteration: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almasaqu

verses.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
translations.en.transliteration: Fal<u>a</u> <u>s</u>addaqa wal<u>a</u> <u>s</u>all<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
translations.en.transliteration: Wal<u>a</u>kin ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma <u>th</u>ahaba il<u>a</u> ahlihi yatama<u>tta</u>

verses.arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Woe to you, and woe!
translations.en.transliteration: Awl<u>a</u> laka faawl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then woe to you, and woe!
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma awl<u>a</u> laka faawl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى

translations.en.sahih: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
translations.en.transliteration: Ayahsabu alinsanu an yutraka sudan

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yaku nu<u>t</u>fatan min manayyin yumn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma k<u>a</u>na AAalaqatan fakhalaqa fasaww<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAala minhu alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
translations.en.transliteration: Alaysa <u>tha</u>lika biq<u>a</u>dirin AAal<u>a</u> an yu<u>h</u>yiya almawt<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى الْإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئًا مَّذْكُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلَاسِلَ وَأَغْلَالًا وَسَعِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
translations.en.transliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

verses.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
translations.en.transliteration: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

verses.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
translations.en.transliteration: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَاءً وَلَا شُكُورًا

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
translations.en.transliteration: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

verses.arabic: فَوَقَاهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

translations.en.sahih: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
translations.en.transliteration: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

verses.arabic: وَجَزَاهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
translations.en.transliteration: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

verses.arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
translations.en.transliteration: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

verses.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
translations.en.transliteration: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

verses.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا

translations.en.sahih: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
translations.en.transliteration: Wayu<u>ta</u>fu AAalayhim bi<u>a</u>niyatin min fi<u>dd</u>atin waakw<u>a</u>bin k<u>a</u>nat qaw<u>a</u>reer<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَوَارِيرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
translations.en.transliteration: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

verses.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
translations.en.transliteration: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
translations.en.transliteration: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

verses.arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا

translations.en.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

verses.arabic: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوا أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
translations.en.transliteration: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

translations.en.sahih: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

verses.arabic: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ آثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا

translations.en.sahih: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
translations.en.transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

verses.arabic: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
translations.en.transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

verses.arabic: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
translations.en.transliteration: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ يُحِبُّونَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَاءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَا أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
translations.en.transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

verses.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَاءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ ۚ وَالظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

translations.en.sahih: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman

verses.arabic: وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا

translations.en.sahih: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
translations.en.transliteration: Waalmursalati AAurfan

verses.arabic: فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفًا

translations.en.sahih: And the winds that blow violently
translations.en.transliteration: FaalAAasifati AAasfan

verses.arabic: وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnashirati nashran

verses.arabic: فَالْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقًا

translations.en.sahih: And those [angels] who bring criterion
translations.en.transliteration: Faalfariqati farqan

verses.arabic: فَالْمُلْقِيَاتِ ذِكْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And those [angels] who deliver a message
translations.en.transliteration: Faalmulqiyati thikran

verses.arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا

translations.en.sahih: As justification or warning,
translations.en.transliteration: AAuthran aw nuthran

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَاقِعٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
translations.en.transliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAAun

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ

translations.en.sahih: So when the stars are obliterated
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha alnnujoomu tumisat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ فُرِجَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the heaven is opened
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alssamao furijat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the mountains are blown away
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> aljib<u>a</u>lu nusifat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the messengers' time has come...
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alrrusulu oqqitat

verses.arabic: لِأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ

translations.en.sahih: For what Day was it postponed?
translations.en.transliteration: Liayyi yawmin ojjilat

verses.arabic: لِيَوْمِ الْفَصْلِ

translations.en.sahih: For the Day of Judgement.
translations.en.transliteration: Liyawmi alfasli

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma yawmu alfasli

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam nuhliki alawwaleena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ الْآخِرِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma nutbiAAuhumu alakhireena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِالْمُجْرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّاءٍ مَّهِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam nakhluqkum min main maheenin

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And We placed it in a firm lodging
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAalnahu fee qararin makeenin

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: For a known extent.
translations.en.transliteration: Ila qadarin maAAloomin

verses.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
translations.en.transliteration: Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroona

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made the earth a container
translations.en.transliteration: Alam najAAali alarda kifatan

verses.arabic: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: Of the living and the dead?
translations.en.transliteration: Ahyaan waamwatan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّاءً فُرَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
translations.en.transliteration: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ

translations.en.sahih: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
translations.en.transliteration: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin

verses.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ

translations.en.sahih: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
translations.en.transliteration: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
translations.en.transliteration: Innaha tarmee bishararin kaalqasri

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ

translations.en.sahih: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaannahu jimalatun sufrun

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ

translations.en.sahih: This is a Day they will not speak,
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha yawmu la yantiqoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yuthanu lahum fayaAAtathiroona

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakum waalawwaleena

verses.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ

translations.en.sahih: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
translations.en.transliteration: Fain kana lakum kaydun fakeedooni

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
translations.en.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And fruits from whatever they desire,
translations.en.transliteration: Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoona

verses.arabic: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
translations.en.transliteration: Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakum mujrimoona

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
translations.en.transliteration: Fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona

verses.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: About what are they asking one another?
translations.en.transliteration: AAamma yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: About the great news -
translations.en.transliteration: AAani alnnabai alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: That over which they are in disagreement.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee hum feehi mukhtalifoona

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No! They are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla sayaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then, no! They are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma kalla sayaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam najAAali alarda mihadan

verses.arabic: وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains as stakes?
translations.en.transliteration: Waaljibala awtadan

verses.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: And We created you in pairs
translations.en.transliteration: Wakhalaqnakum azwajan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna nawmakum subatan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا

translations.en.sahih: And made the night as clothing
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna allayla libasan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا

translations.en.sahih: And made the day for livelihood
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna alnnahara maAAashan

verses.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا

translations.en.sahih: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
translations.en.transliteration: Wabanayna fawqakum sabAAan shidadan

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا

translations.en.sahih: And made [therein] a burning lamp
translations.en.transliteration: WajaAAalna sirajan wahhajan

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا

translations.en.sahih: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
translations.en.transliteration: Waanzalna mina almuAAsirati maan thajjajan

verses.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
translations.en.transliteration: Linukhrija bihi habban wanabatan

verses.arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا

translations.en.sahih: And gardens of entwined growth.
translations.en.transliteration: Wajannatin alfafan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna yawma alfasli kana meeqatan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan

verses.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا

translations.en.sahih: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
translations.en.transliteration: Wafutihati alssamao fakanat abwaban

verses.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
translations.en.transliteration: Wasuyyirati aljibalu fakanat saraban

verses.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
translations.en.transliteration: Inna jahannama kanat mirsadan

verses.arabic: لِّلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا

translations.en.sahih: For the transgressors, a place of return,
translations.en.transliteration: Lilttagheena maaban

verses.arabic: لَّابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا

translations.en.sahih: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
translations.en.transliteration: Labitheena feeha ahqaban

verses.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا

translations.en.sahih: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
translations.en.transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban

verses.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا

translations.en.sahih: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
translations.en.transliteration: Illa hameeman waghassaqan

verses.arabic: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا

translations.en.sahih: An appropriate recompense.
translations.en.transliteration: Jazaan wifaqan

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا

translations.en.sahih: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban

verses.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا

translations.en.sahih: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا

translations.en.sahih: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
translations.en.transliteration: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
translations.en.transliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan

verses.arabic: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا

translations.en.sahih: Gardens and grapevines
translations.en.transliteration: Hadaiqa waaAAnaban

verses.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا

translations.en.sahih: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
translations.en.transliteration: WakawaAAiba atraban

verses.arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا

translations.en.sahih: And a full cup.
translations.en.transliteration: Wakasan dihaqan

verses.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا

translations.en.sahih: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
translations.en.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban

verses.arabic: جَزَاءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا

translations.en.sahih: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
translations.en.transliteration: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban

verses.arabic: رَّبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا

translations.en.sahih: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
translations.en.transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا

translations.en.sahih: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا

translations.en.sahih: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
translations.en.transliteration: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
translations.en.transliteration: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban

verses.arabic: وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا

translations.en.sahih: By those [angels] who extract with violence
translations.en.transliteration: WaalnnaziAAati gharqan

verses.arabic: وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] those who remove with ease
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnashitati nashtan

verses.arabic: وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssabihati sabhan

verses.arabic: فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who race each other in a race
translations.en.transliteration: Faalssabiqati sabqan

verses.arabic: فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا

translations.en.sahih: And those who arrange [each] matter,
translations.en.transliteration: Faalmudabbirati amran

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ

translations.en.sahih: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu

verses.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ

translations.en.sahih: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
translations.en.transliteration: TatbaAAuha alrradifatu

verses.arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
translations.en.transliteration: Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun

verses.arabic: أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled.
translations.en.transliteration: Absaruha khashiAAatun

verses.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ

translations.en.sahih: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
translations.en.transliteration: Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati

verses.arabic: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَّخِرَةً

translations.en.sahih: Even if we should be decayed bones?
translations.en.transliteration: Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan

verses.arabic: قَالُوا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
translations.en.transliteration: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
translations.en.transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِالسَّاهِرَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha hum bialssahirati

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
translations.en.transliteration: Hal at<u>a</u>ka <u>h</u>adeethu moos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى

translations.en.sahih: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
translations.en.transliteration: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

verses.arabic: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u>hab il<u>a</u> firAAawna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
translations.en.transliteration: Faqul hal laka il<u>a</u> an tazakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
translations.en.transliteration: Waahdiyaka il<u>a</u> rabbika fatakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَرَاهُ الْآيَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he showed him the greatest sign,
translations.en.transliteration: Faar<u>a</u>hu al<u>a</u>yata alkubr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
translations.en.transliteration: Faka<u>thth</u>aba waAAa<u>sa</u>

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then he turned his back, striving.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma adbara yasAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he gathered [his people] and called out
translations.en.transliteration: Fa<u>h</u>ashara fan<u>a</u>d<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْأَعْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
translations.en.transliteration: Faq<u>a</u>la an<u>a</u> rabbukumu alaAAl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ نَكَالَ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
translations.en.transliteration: Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Inna fee <u>tha</u>lika laAAibratan liman yakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
translations.en.transliteration: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha

verses.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
translations.en.transliteration: RafaAAa samkah<u>a</u> fasaww<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
translations.en.transliteration: Waagh<u>t</u>asha laylah<u>a</u> waakhraja <u>d</u>u<u>ha</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And after that He spread the earth.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha

verses.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
translations.en.transliteration: Akhraja minh<u>a</u> m<u>a</u>ah<u>a</u> wamarAA<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains He set firmly
translations.en.transliteration: Waaljibala arsaha

verses.arabic: مَتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ

translations.en.sahih: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.en.transliteration: Mat<u>a</u>AAan lakum walianAA<u>a</u>mikum

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yata<u>th</u>akkaru alins<u>a</u>nu m<u>a</u> saAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
translations.en.transliteration: Waburrizati alja<u>h</u>eemu liman yar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So as for he who transgressed
translations.en.transliteration: Faamm<u>a</u> man <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَآثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

translations.en.sahih: And preferred the life of the world,
translations.en.transliteration: Waathara alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainna alja<u>h</u>eema hiya almaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
translations.en.transliteration: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainna aljannata hiya almaw<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
translations.en.transliteration: Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha

verses.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
translations.en.transliteration: Feema anta min <u>th</u>ikr<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: To your Lord is its finality.
translations.en.transliteration: Il<u>a</u> rabbika muntah<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
translations.en.transliteration: Innam<u>a</u> anta mun<u>th</u>iru man yakhsh<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
translations.en.transliteration: Kaannahum yawma yarawnah<u>a</u> lam yalbathoo ill<u>a</u> AAashiyyatan aw <u>d</u>u<u>ha</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The Prophet frowned and turned away
translations.en.transliteration: AAabasa watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَن جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
translations.en.transliteration: An j<u>a</u>ahu alaAAm<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
translations.en.transliteration: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra

verses.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: As for he who thinks himself without need,
translations.en.transliteration: Amm<u>a</u> mani istaghn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: To him you give attention.
translations.en.transliteration: Faanta lahu ta<u>s</u>add<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> AAalayka all<u>a</u> yazzakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
translations.en.transliteration: Waamm<u>a</u> man j<u>a</u>aka yasAA<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: While he fears [Allah],
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa yakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: From him you are distracted.
translations.en.transliteration: Faanta AAanhu talahh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla innaha tathkiratun

verses.arabic: فَمَن شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: So whoever wills may remember it.
translations.en.transliteration: Faman shaa thakarahu

verses.arabic: فِي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
translations.en.transliteration: Fee suhufin mukarramatin

verses.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Exalted and purified,
translations.en.transliteration: MarfooAAatin mutahharatin

verses.arabic: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
translations.en.transliteration: Biaydee safaratin

verses.arabic: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Noble and dutiful.
translations.en.transliteration: Kiramin bararatin

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
translations.en.transliteration: Qutila alinsanu ma akfarahu

verses.arabic: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ

translations.en.sahih: From what substance did He create him?
translations.en.transliteration: Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu

verses.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
translations.en.transliteration: Min nutfatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then He eased the way for him;
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma alssabeela yassarahu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنشَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma itha shaa ansharahu

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu

verses.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ

translations.en.sahih: Then let mankind look at his food -
translations.en.transliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi

verses.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا

translations.en.sahih: How We poured down water in torrents,
translations.en.transliteration: Anna sababna almaa sabban

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا

translations.en.sahih: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan

verses.arabic: فَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا

translations.en.sahih: And caused to grow within it grain
translations.en.transliteration: Faanbatna feeha habban

verses.arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا

translations.en.sahih: And grapes and herbage
translations.en.transliteration: WaAAinaban waqadban

verses.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا

translations.en.sahih: And olive and palm trees
translations.en.transliteration: Wazaytoonan wanakhlan

verses.arabic: وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا

translations.en.sahih: And gardens of dense shrubbery
translations.en.transliteration: Wahadaiqa ghulban

verses.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا

translations.en.sahih: And fruit and grass -
translations.en.transliteration: Wafakihatan waabban

verses.arabic: مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ

translations.en.sahih: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
translations.en.transliteration: Mat<u>a</u>AAan lakum walianAA<u>a</u>mikum

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ

translations.en.sahih: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi

verses.arabic: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: And his mother and his father
translations.en.transliteration: Waommihi waabeehi

verses.arabic: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: And his wife and his children,
translations.en.transliteration: Wasahibatihi wabaneehi

verses.arabic: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
translations.en.transliteration: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
translations.en.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun

verses.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
translations.en.transliteration: Dahikatun mustabshiratun

verses.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun

verses.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Blackness will cover them.
translations.en.transliteration: Tarhaquha qataratun

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu

verses.arabic: إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
translations.en.transliteration: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انكَدَرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the mountains are removed
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> aljib<u>a</u>lu suyyirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alAAish<u>a</u>ru AAu<u>tt</u>ilat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the wild beasts are gathered
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alwu<u>h</u>ooshu <u>h</u>ushirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the seas are filled with flame
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> albi<u>ha</u>ru sujjirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the souls are paired
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alnnufoosu zuwwijat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> almawoodatu suilat

verses.arabic: بِأَيِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ

translations.en.sahih: For what sin she was killed
translations.en.transliteration: Biayyi <u>th</u>anbin qutilat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the pages are made public
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alssuhufu nushirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the sky is stripped away
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha alssamao kushitat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alja<u>h</u>eemu suAAAAirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when Paradise is brought near,
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> aljannatu ozlifat

verses.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا أَحْضَرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
translations.en.transliteration: AAalimat nafsun m<u>a</u> a<u>hd</u>arat

verses.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the retreating stars -
translations.en.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi

verses.arabic: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ

translations.en.sahih: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
translations.en.transliteration: Aljawari alkunnasi

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ

translations.en.sahih: And by the night as it closes in
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli itha AAasAAasa

verses.arabic: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ

translations.en.sahih: And by the dawn when it breathes
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

verses.arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
translations.en.transliteration: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin

verses.arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
translations.en.transliteration: MutaAAin thamma ameenin

verses.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
translations.en.transliteration: Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ

translations.en.sahih: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
