translations.en.transliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin

verses.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So where are you going?
translations.en.transliteration: Faayna tathhaboona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
translations.en.transliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

verses.arabic: لِمَن شَاءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
translations.en.transliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

verses.arabic: إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انفَطَرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: When the sky breaks apart
translations.en.transliteration: Itha alssamao infatarat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انتَثَرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the stars fall, scattering,
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alkaw<u>a</u>kibu intatharat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the seas are erupted
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> albi<u>ha</u>ru fujjirat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alqubooru buAAthirat

verses.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ

translations.en.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
translations.en.transliteration: AAalimat nafsun m<u>a</u> qaddamat waakhkharat

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ

translations.en.sahih: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka

verses.arabic: فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ

translations.en.sahih: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
translations.en.transliteration: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka

verses.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: No! But you deny the Recompense.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena

verses.arabic: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Noble and recording;
translations.en.transliteration: Kiraman katibeena

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: They know whatever you do.
translations.en.transliteration: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin

verses.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
translations.en.transliteration: Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And never therefrom will they be absent.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ

translations.en.sahih: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe to those who give less [than due],
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun lilmutaffifeena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona

verses.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُولَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
translations.en.transliteration: Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona

verses.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: For a tremendous Day -
translations.en.transliteration: Liyawmin AAatheemin

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma sijjeenun

verses.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
translations.en.transliteration: Kitabun marqoomun

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.en.transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُو الْجَحِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا الَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona

verses.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ

translations.en.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
translations.en.transliteration: Kitabun marqoomun

verses.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

verses.arabic: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

verses.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
translations.en.transliteration: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin

verses.arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ

translations.en.sahih: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
translations.en.transliteration: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona

verses.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
translations.en.transliteration: Wamizajuhu min tasneemin

verses.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
translations.en.transliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا انقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ

translations.en.sahih: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

verses.arabic: وَمَا أُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ

translations.en.sahih: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena

verses.arabic: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
translations.en.transliteration: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona

verses.arabic: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
translations.en.transliteration: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona

verses.arabic: إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انشَقَّتْ

translations.en.sahih: When the sky has split [open]
translations.en.transliteration: Itha alssamao inshaqqat

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

translations.en.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
translations.en.transliteration: Waa<u>th</u>inat lirabbih<u>a</u> wa<u>h</u>uqqat

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ

translations.en.sahih: And when the earth has been extended
translations.en.transliteration: Wai<u>tha</u> alar<u>d</u>u muddat

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ

translations.en.sahih: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqat m<u>a</u> feeh<u>a</u> watakhallat

verses.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ

translations.en.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
translations.en.transliteration: Waa<u>th</u>inat lirabbih<u>a</u> wa<u>h</u>uqqat

verses.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ

translations.en.sahih: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ

translations.en.sahih: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
translations.en.transliteration: Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: He will be judged with an easy account
translations.en.transliteration: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran

verses.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

translations.en.sahih: And return to his people in happiness.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi

verses.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا

translations.en.sahih: He will cry out for destruction
translations.en.transliteration: Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran

verses.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
translations.en.transliteration: Wayasla saAAeeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu thanna an lan yahoora

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا

translations.en.sahih: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
translations.en.transliteration: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran

verses.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ

translations.en.sahih: So I swear by the twilight glow
translations.en.transliteration: Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night and what it envelops
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli wama wasaqa

verses.arabic: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqamari itha ittasaqa

verses.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ

translations.en.sahih: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
translations.en.transliteration: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.en.sahih: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
translations.en.transliteration: Fama lahum la yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩

translations.en.sahih: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
translations.en.transliteration: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona

verses.arabic: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ

translations.en.sahih: But those who have disbelieved deny,
translations.en.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona

verses.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
translations.en.transliteration: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

verses.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ

translations.en.sahih: By the sky containing great stars
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alburooji

verses.arabic: وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the promised Day
translations.en.transliteration: Waalyawmi almawAAoodi

verses.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
translations.en.transliteration: Washahidin wamashhoodin

verses.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ

translations.en.sahih: Cursed were the companions of the trench
translations.en.transliteration: Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi

verses.arabic: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ

translations.en.sahih: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
translations.en.transliteration: Alnnari thati alwaqoodi

verses.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ

translations.en.sahih: When they were sitting near it
translations.en.transliteration: Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun

verses.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ

translations.en.sahih: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
translations.en.transliteration: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun

verses.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَن يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ

translations.en.sahih: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
translations.en.transliteration: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi

verses.arabic: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru

verses.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ

translations.en.sahih: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
translations.en.transliteration: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu

verses.arabic: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ

translations.en.sahih: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
translations.en.transliteration: Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi

verses.arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

translations.en.sahih: Effecter of what He intends.
translations.en.transliteration: FaAAAAalun lima yureedu

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
translations.en.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi

verses.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

translations.en.sahih: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
translations.en.transliteration: FirAAawna wathamooda

verses.arabic: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ

translations.en.sahih: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
translations.en.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin

verses.arabic: وَاللَّهُ مِن وَرَائِهِم مُّحِيطٌ

translations.en.sahih: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
translations.en.transliteration: WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: But this is an honored Qur'an
translations.en.transliteration: Bal huwa quranun majeedun

verses.arabic: فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ

translations.en.sahih: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
translations.en.transliteration: Fee lawhin mahfoothin

verses.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ

translations.en.sahih: By the sky and the night comer -
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamai waalttariqi

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alttariqu

verses.arabic: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ

translations.en.sahih: It is the piercing star -
translations.en.transliteration: Alnnajmu alththaqibu

verses.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

translations.en.sahih: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
translations.en.transliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun

verses.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ الْإِنسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

translations.en.sahih: So let man observe from what he was created.
translations.en.transliteration: Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa

verses.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّاءٍ دَافِقٍ

translations.en.sahih: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
translations.en.transliteration: Khuliqa min main dafiqin

verses.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِن بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ

translations.en.sahih: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
translations.en.transliteration: Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ

translations.en.sahih: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma tubla alssarairu

verses.arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Then man will have no power or any helper.
translations.en.transliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin

verses.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ

translations.en.sahih: By the sky which returns [rain]
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi

verses.arabic: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
translations.en.transliteration: Waalardi thati alssadAAi

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
translations.en.transliteration: Innahu laqawlun faslun

verses.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ

translations.en.sahih: And it is not amusement.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama huwa bialhazli

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
translations.en.transliteration: Innahum yakeedoona kaydan

verses.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا

translations.en.sahih: But I am planning a plan.
translations.en.transliteration: Waakeedu kaydan

verses.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا

translations.en.sahih: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
translations.en.transliteration: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan

verses.arabic: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى

translations.en.sahih: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
translations.en.transliteration: Sabbi<u>h</u>i isma rabbika alaAAl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Who created and proportioned
translations.en.transliteration: Alla<u>th</u>ee khalaqa fasaww<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And who destined and [then] guided
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee qaddara fahada

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And who brings out the pasture
translations.en.transliteration: Waallathee akhraja almarAAa

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [then] makes it black stubble.
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAalahu ghuth<u>a</u>an a<u>h</u>w<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
translations.en.transliteration: Sanuqrioka fal<u>a</u> tans<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
translations.en.transliteration: Ill<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> sh<u>a</u>a All<u>a</u>hu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wam<u>a</u> yakhf<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And We will ease you toward ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Wanuyassiruka lilyusr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
translations.en.transliteration: Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra

verses.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
translations.en.transliteration: Saya<u>thth</u>akkaru man yakhsh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى

translations.en.sahih: But the wretched one will avoid it -
translations.en.transliteration: Wayatajannabuh<u>a</u> alashq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Neither dying therein nor living.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma l<u>a</u> yamootu feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ya<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
translations.en.transliteration: Qad afla<u>h</u>a man tazakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
translations.en.transliteration: Wa<u>th</u>akara isma rabbihi fa<u>s</u>all<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا

translations.en.sahih: But you prefer the worldly life,
translations.en.transliteration: Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
translations.en.transliteration: Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola

verses.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
translations.en.transliteration: <u>S</u>u<u>h</u>ufi ibr<u>a</u>heema wamoos<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
translations.en.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun

verses.arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Working [hard] and exhausted.
translations.en.transliteration: AAamilatun nasibatun

verses.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً

translations.en.sahih: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
translations.en.transliteration: Tasla naran hamiyatan

verses.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
translations.en.transliteration: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin

verses.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ

translations.en.sahih: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
translations.en.transliteration: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

verses.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِن جُوعٍ

translations.en.sahih: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
translations.en.transliteration: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin

verses.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun

verses.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: With their effort [they are] satisfied
translations.en.transliteration: LisaAAyiha radiyatun

verses.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: In an elevated garden,
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

verses.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً

translations.en.sahih: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
translations.en.transliteration: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan

verses.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Within it is a flowing spring.
translations.en.transliteration: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun

verses.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Within it are couches raised high
translations.en.transliteration: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun

verses.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And cups put in place
translations.en.transliteration: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun

verses.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And cushions lined up
translations.en.transliteration: Wanamariqu masfoofatun

verses.arabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: And carpets spread around.
translations.en.transliteration: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

translations.en.sahih: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
translations.en.transliteration: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And at the sky - how it is raised?
translations.en.transliteration: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
translations.en.transliteration: Wail<u>a</u> aljib<u>a</u>li kayfa nu<u>s</u>ibat

verses.arabic: وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

translations.en.sahih: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
translations.en.transliteration: Wail<u>a</u> alar<u>d</u>i kayfa su<u>t</u>i<u>h</u>at

verses.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ

translations.en.sahih: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
translations.en.transliteration: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun

verses.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

translations.en.sahih: You are not over them a controller.
translations.en.transliteration: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

translations.en.sahih: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
translations.en.transliteration: Illa man tawalla wakafara

verses.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, to Us is their return.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna ilayn<u>a</u> iy<u>a</u>bahum

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma inna AAalayn<u>a</u> <u>h</u>is<u>a</u>bahum

verses.arabic: وَالْفَجْرِ

translations.en.sahih: By the dawn
translations.en.transliteration: Waalfajri

verses.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] ten nights
translations.en.transliteration: Walayalin AAashrin

verses.arabic: وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
translations.en.transliteration: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it passes,
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli itha yasri

verses.arabic: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
translations.en.transliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

translations.en.sahih: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin

verses.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ

translations.en.sahih: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
translations.en.transliteration: Irama thati alAAimadi

verses.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ

translations.en.sahih: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
translations.en.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi

verses.arabic: وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ

translations.en.sahih: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
translations.en.transliteration: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi

verses.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ

translations.en.sahih: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
translations.en.transliteration: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ

translations.en.sahih: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi

verses.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ

translations.en.sahih: And increased therein the corruption.
translations.en.transliteration: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada

verses.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

translations.en.sahih: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْإِنسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ

translations.en.sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ

translations.en.sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: No! But you do not honor the orphan
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni

verses.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا

translations.en.sahih: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
translations.en.transliteration: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman

verses.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا

translations.en.sahih: And you love wealth with immense love.
translations.en.transliteration: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا

translations.en.sahih: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan

verses.arabic: وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
translations.en.transliteration: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan

verses.arabic: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
translations.en.transliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي

translations.en.sahih: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
translations.en.transliteration: Yaqoolu y<u>a</u> laytanee qaddamtu li<u>h</u>ay<u>a</u>tee

verses.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
translations.en.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun

verses.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun

verses.arabic: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

translations.en.sahih: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
translations.en.transliteration: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu

verses.arabic: ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً

translations.en.sahih: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
translations.en.transliteration: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan

verses.arabic: فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي

translations.en.sahih: And enter among My [righteous] servants
translations.en.transliteration: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee

verses.arabic: وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي

translations.en.sahih: And enter My Paradise."
translations.en.transliteration: Waodkhulee jannatee

verses.arabic: لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ

translations.en.sahih: I swear by this city, Makkah -
translations.en.transliteration: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi

verses.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّ بِهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ

translations.en.sahih: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
translations.en.transliteration: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi

verses.arabic: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
translations.en.transliteration: Wawalidin wama walada

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly created man into hardship.
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
translations.en.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

verses.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا

translations.en.sahih: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
translations.en.transliteration: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Does he think that no one has seen him?
translations.en.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُ عَيْنَيْنِ

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made for him two eyes?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni

verses.arabic: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

translations.en.sahih: And a tongue and two lips?
translations.en.transliteration: Walisanan washafatayni

verses.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ

translations.en.sahih: And have shown him the two ways?
translations.en.transliteration: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni

verses.arabic: فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ

translations.en.sahih: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
translations.en.transliteration: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu

verses.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: It is the freeing of a slave
translations.en.transliteration: Fakku raqabatin

verses.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
translations.en.transliteration: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

verses.arabic: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: An orphan of near relationship
translations.en.transliteration: Yateeman tha maqrabatin

verses.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Or a needy person in misery
translations.en.transliteration: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

verses.arabic: أُولَـٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Those are the companions of the right.
translations.en.transliteration: Olaika ashabu almaymanati

verses.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ

translations.en.sahih: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
translations.en.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

verses.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Over them will be fire closed in.
translations.en.transliteration: AAalayhim narun musadatun

verses.arabic: وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: By the sun and its brightness
translations.en.transliteration: Waalshshamsi waduhaha

verses.arabic: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the moon when it follows it
translations.en.transliteration: Waalqamari itha talaha

verses.arabic: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the day when it displays it
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha jallaha

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers it
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghshaha

verses.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
translations.en.transliteration: Waalssamai wama banaha

verses.arabic: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
translations.en.transliteration: Waalardi wama tahaha

verses.arabic: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
translations.en.transliteration: Wanafsin wam<u>a</u> saww<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
translations.en.transliteration: Faalhamah<u>a</u> fujoorah<u>a</u> wataqw<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: He has succeeded who purifies it,
translations.en.transliteration: Qad afla<u>h</u>a man zakk<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
translations.en.transliteration: Waqad kh<u>a</u>ba man dass<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
translations.en.transliteration: Ka<u>thth</u>abat thamoodu bi<u>t</u>aghw<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِذِ انبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>th</u>i inbaAAatha ashq<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
translations.en.transliteration: Faq<u>a</u>la lahum rasoolu All<u>a</u>hi n<u>a</u>qata All<u>a</u>hi wasuqy<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا

translations.en.sahih: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
translations.en.transliteration: Faka<u>thth</u>aboohu faAAaqarooh<u>a</u> fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bi<u>th</u>anbihim fasaww<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا

translations.en.sahih: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
translations.en.transliteration: Wal<u>a</u> yakh<u>a</u>fu AAuqb<u>a</u>h<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: By the night when it covers
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli itha yaghsha

verses.arabic: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the day when it appears
translations.en.transliteration: Waalnnahari itha tajalla

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنثَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] He who created the male and female,
translations.en.transliteration: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha

verses.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna saAAyakum lashatt<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: As for he who gives and fears Allah
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa

verses.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And believes in the best [reward],
translations.en.transliteration: Wasaddaqa bialhusna

verses.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: We will ease him toward ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And denies the best [reward],
translations.en.transliteration: Wakaththaba bialhusna

verses.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: We will ease him toward difficulty.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusr<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> yughnee AAanhu m<u>a</u>luhu i<u>tha</u> taradd<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna AAalayn<u>a</u> lalhud<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
translations.en.transliteration: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola

verses.arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
translations.en.transliteration: Faanthartukum naran talaththa

verses.arabic: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى

translations.en.sahih: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
translations.en.transliteration: L<u>a</u> ya<u>s</u>l<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> ill<u>a</u> alashq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Who had denied and turned away.
translations.en.transliteration: Alla<u>th</u>ee ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى

translations.en.sahih: But the righteous one will avoid it -
translations.en.transliteration: Wasayujannabuh<u>a</u> alatq<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
translations.en.transliteration: Alla<u>th</u>ee yutee m<u>a</u>lahu yatazakk<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
translations.en.transliteration: Wam<u>a</u> lia<u>h</u>adin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujz<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
translations.en.transliteration: Ill<u>a</u> ibtigh<u>a</u>a wajhi rabbihi alaAAl<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And he is going to be satisfied.
translations.en.transliteration: Walasawfa yar<u>da</u>

verses.arabic: وَالضُّحَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: By the morning brightness
translations.en.transliteration: Waaldduha

verses.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
translations.en.transliteration: Waallayli itha saja

verses.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
translations.en.transliteration: M<u>a</u> waddaAAaka rabbuka wam<u>a</u> qal<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَّكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
translations.en.transliteration: Walal<u>a</u>khiratu khayrun laka mina alool<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
translations.en.transliteration: Walasawfa yuAA<u>t</u>eeka rabbuka fatar<u>da</u>

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yajidka yateeman fa<u>a</u>w<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And He found you lost and guided [you],
translations.en.transliteration: Wawajadaka <u>da</u>llan fahad<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
translations.en.transliteration: Wawajadaka AA<u>a</u>ilan faaghn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

translations.en.sahih: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
translations.en.transliteration: Faamm<u>a</u> alyateema fal<u>a</u> taqhar

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

translations.en.sahih: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma alssaila fala tanhar

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

translations.en.sahih: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
translations.en.transliteration: Waamm<u>a</u> biniAAmati rabbika fa<u>h</u>addith

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

translations.en.sahih: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam nashrah laka sadraka

verses.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

translations.en.sahih: And We removed from you your burden
translations.en.transliteration: WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka

verses.arabic: الَّذِي أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

translations.en.sahih: Which had weighed upon your back
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee anqada thahraka

verses.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

translations.en.sahih: And raised high for you your repute.
translations.en.transliteration: WarafaAAna laka thikraka

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Fainna maAAa alAAusri yusran

verses.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusran

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانصَبْ

translations.en.sahih: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
translations.en.transliteration: Faitha faraghta fainsab

verses.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَب

translations.en.sahih: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
translations.en.transliteration: Waila rabbika fairghab

verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ

translations.en.sahih: By the fig and the olive
translations.en.transliteration: Waaltteeni waalzzaytooni

verses.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] Mount Sinai
translations.en.transliteration: Watoori seeneena

verses.arabic: وَهَـٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
translations.en.transliteration: Wahatha albaladi alameeni

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
translations.en.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileena

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

verses.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
translations.en.transliteration: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu bialddeeni

verses.arabic: أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
translations.en.transliteration: Alaysa Allahu biahkami alhakimeena

verses.arabic: اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ

translations.en.sahih: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
translations.en.transliteration: Iqra biismi rabbika allathee khalaqa

verses.arabic: خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

translations.en.sahih: Created man from a clinging substance.
translations.en.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min AAalaqin

verses.arabic: اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ

translations.en.sahih: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
translations.en.transliteration: Iqra warabbuka alakramu

verses.arabic: الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ

translations.en.sahih: Who taught by the pen -
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee AAallama bialqalami

verses.arabic: عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

translations.en.sahih: Taught man that which he knew not.
translations.en.transliteration: AAallama alins<u>a</u>na m<u>a</u> lam yaAAlam

verses.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَيَطْغَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
translations.en.transliteration: Kall<u>a</u> inna alins<u>a</u>na laya<u>t</u>gh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَن رَّآهُ اسْتَغْنَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
translations.en.transliteration: An ra<u>a</u>hu istaghn<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الرُّجْعَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna ila rabbika alrrujAAa

verses.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يَنْهَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who forbids
translations.en.transliteration: Araayta alla<u>th</u>ee yanh<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: A servant when he prays?
translations.en.transliteration: AAabdan i<u>tha</u> <u>s</u>all<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
translations.en.transliteration: Araayta in k<u>a</u>na AAal<u>a</u> alhud<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِالتَّقْوَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Or enjoins righteousness?
translations.en.transliteration: Aw amara bialttaqwa

verses.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
translations.en.transliteration: Araayta in ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

translations.en.sahih: Does he not know that Allah sees?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yaAAlam bianna All<u>a</u>ha yar<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًا بِالنَّاصِيَةِ

translations.en.sahih: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

verses.arabic: نَاصِيَةٍ كَاذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: A lying, sinning forelock.
translations.en.transliteration: Nasiyatin kathibatin khatiatin

verses.arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then let him call his associates;
translations.en.transliteration: FalyadAAu nadiyahu

verses.arabic: سَنَدْعُ الزَّبَانِيَةَ

translations.en.sahih: We will call the angels of Hell.
translations.en.transliteration: SanadAAu alzzabaniyata

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِب ۩

translations.en.sahih: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla la tutiAAhu waosjud waiqtarib

verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylati alqadri

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma laylatu alqadri

verses.arabic: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ

translations.en.sahih: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
translations.en.transliteration: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

verses.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ

translations.en.sahih: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
translations.en.transliteration: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

verses.arabic: سَلَامٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ الْفَجْرِ

translations.en.sahih: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
translations.en.transliteration: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAi alfajri

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

translations.en.sahih: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
translations.en.transliteration: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu

verses.arabic: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ يَتْلُو صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً

translations.en.sahih: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
translations.en.transliteration: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan

verses.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌ قَيِّمَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Within which are correct writings.
translations.en.transliteration: Feeha kutubun qayyimatun

verses.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا مِن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ

translations.en.sahih: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu

verses.arabic: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ حُنَفَاءَ وَيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَيُؤْتُوا الزَّكَاةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ الْقَيِّمَةِ

translations.en.sahih: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
translations.en.transliteration: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ الْبَرِيَّةِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَـٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati

verses.arabic: جَزَاؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ رَبَّهُ

translations.en.sahih: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
translations.en.transliteration: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu

verses.arabic: إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

translations.en.sahih: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
translations.en.transliteration: I<u>tha</u> zulzilati alar<u>d</u>u zilz<u>a</u>lah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ الْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

translations.en.sahih: And the earth discharges its burdens
translations.en.transliteration: Waakhrajati alar<u>d</u>u athq<u>a</u>lah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ الْإِنسَانُ مَا لَهَا

translations.en.sahih: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
translations.en.transliteration: Waq<u>a</u>la alins<u>a</u>nu m<u>a</u> lah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

translations.en.sahih: That Day, it will report its news
translations.en.transliteration: Yawmai<u>th</u>in tu<u>h</u>addithu akhb<u>a</u>rah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

translations.en.sahih: Because your Lord has commanded it.
translations.en.transliteration: Bianna rabbaka aw<u>ha</u> lah<u>a</u>

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ النَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا أَعْمَالَهُمْ

translations.en.sahih: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
translations.en.transliteration: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

verses.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
translations.en.transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ

translations.en.sahih: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
translations.en.transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

verses.arabic: وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا

translations.en.sahih: By the racers, panting,
translations.en.transliteration: WaalAAadiyati dabhan

verses.arabic: فَالْمُورِيَاتِ قَدْحًا

translations.en.sahih: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
translations.en.transliteration: Faalmooriyati qadhan

verses.arabic: فَالْمُغِيرَاتِ صُبْحًا

translations.en.sahih: And the chargers at dawn,
translations.en.transliteration: Faalmugheerati subhan

verses.arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِ نَقْعًا

translations.en.sahih: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
translations.en.transliteration: Faatharna bihi naqAAan

verses.arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِ جَمْعًا

translations.en.sahih: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
translations.en.transliteration: Fawasatna bihi jamAAan

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لِرَبِّهِ لَكَنُودٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alinsana lirabbihi lakanoodun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu AAala thalika lashaheedun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

translations.en.sahih: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
translations.en.transliteration: Wainnahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeedun

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي الْقُبُورِ

translations.en.sahih: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
translations.en.transliteration: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

verses.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي الصُّدُورِ

translations.en.sahih: And that within the breasts is obtained,
translations.en.transliteration: Wahussila ma fee alssudoori

verses.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna rabbahum bihim yawmaithin lakhabeerun

verses.arabic: الْقَارِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: The Striking Calamity -
translations.en.transliteration: AlqariAAatu

verses.arabic: مَا الْقَارِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: What is the Striking Calamity?
translations.en.transliteration: Ma alqariAAatu

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْقَارِعَةُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوثِ

translations.en.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
translations.en.transliteration: Yawma yakoonu alnnasu kaalfarashi almabthoothi

verses.arabic: وَتَكُونُ الْجِبَالُ كَالْعِهْنِ الْمَنفُوشِ

translations.en.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
translations.en.transliteration: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni almanfooshi

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

translations.en.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
translations.en.transliteration: Faamma man thaqulat mawazeenuhu

verses.arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.
translations.en.transliteration: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِينُهُ

translations.en.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,
translations.en.transliteration: Waamma man khaffat mawazeenuhu

verses.arabic: فَأُمُّهُ هَاوِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.
translations.en.transliteration: Faommuhu hawiyatun

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا هِيَهْ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma hiyah

verses.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
translations.en.transliteration: Narun hamiyatun

verses.arabic: أَلْهَاكُمُ التَّكَاثُرُ

translations.en.sahih: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
translations.en.transliteration: Alhakumu alttakathuru

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ الْمَقَابِرَ

translations.en.sahih: Until you visit the graveyards.
translations.en.transliteration: Hatta zurtumu almaqabira

verses.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: No! You are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Then no! You are going to know.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ الْيَقِينِ

translations.en.sahih: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla law taAAlamoona AAilma alyaqeeni

verses.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ الْجَحِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: You will surely see the Hellfire.
translations.en.transliteration: Latarawunna aljaheema

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ الْيَقِينِ

translations.en.sahih: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ النَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
translations.en.transliteration: Thumma latusalunna yawmaithin AAani alnnaAAeemi

verses.arabic: وَالْعَصْرِ

translations.en.sahih: By time,
translations.en.transliteration: WaalAAasri

verses.arabic: إِنَّ الْإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
translations.en.transliteration: Inna alinsana lafee khusrin

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ

translations.en.sahih: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
translations.en.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri

verses.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: Woe to every scorner and mocker
translations.en.transliteration: Waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin

verses.arabic: الَّذِي جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ

translations.en.sahih: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee jamaAAa malan waAAaddadahu

verses.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ

translations.en.sahih: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
translations.en.transliteration: Yahsabu anna malahu akhladahu

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنبَذَنَّ فِي الْحُطَمَةِ

translations.en.sahih: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
translations.en.transliteration: Kalla layunbathanna fee alhutamati

verses.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
translations.en.transliteration: Wama adraka ma alhutamatu

verses.arabic: نَارُ اللَّهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ

translations.en.sahih: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
translations.en.transliteration: Naru Allahi almooqadatu

verses.arabic: الَّتِي تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى الْأَفْئِدَةِ

translations.en.sahih: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
translations.en.transliteration: Allatee tattaliAAu AAala alafidati

verses.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
translations.en.transliteration: lnnaha AAalayhim musadatun

verses.arabic: فِي عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ

translations.en.sahih: In extended columns.
translations.en.transliteration: Fee AAamadin mumaddadatin

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ

translations.en.sahih: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ

translations.en.sahih: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
translations.en.transliteration: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleelin

verses.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

translations.en.sahih: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
translations.en.transliteration: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeela

verses.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

translations.en.sahih: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
translations.en.transliteration: Tarmeehim bihijaratin min sijjeelin

verses.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍ مَّأْكُولٍ

translations.en.sahih: And He made them like eaten straw.
translations.en.transliteration: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin makoolin

verses.arabic: لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ

translations.en.sahih: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
translations.en.transliteration: Lieelafi qurayshin

verses.arabic: إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ

translations.en.sahih: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
translations.en.transliteration: Eelafihim rihlata alshshitai waalssayfi

verses.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا رَبَّ هَـٰذَا الْبَيْتِ

translations.en.sahih: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
translations.en.transliteration: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayti

verses.arabic: الَّذِي أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَآمَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍ

translations.en.sahih: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

verses.arabic: أَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي يُكَذِّبُ بِالدِّينِ

translations.en.sahih: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
translations.en.transliteration: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

verses.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ

translations.en.sahih: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
translations.en.transliteration: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAu alyateema

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ

translations.en.sahih: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

verses.arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

translations.en.sahih: So woe to those who pray
translations.en.transliteration: Fawaylun lilmusalleena

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

translations.en.sahih: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena hum AAan salatihim sahoona

verses.arabic: الَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَاءُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Those who make show [of their deeds]
translations.en.transliteration: Allatheena hum yuraoona

verses.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ الْمَاعُونَ

translations.en.sahih: And withhold [simple] assistance.
translations.en.transliteration: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّا أَعْطَيْنَاكَ الْكَوْثَرَ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

verses.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَانْحَرْ

translations.en.sahih: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
translations.en.transliteration: Fasalli lirabbika wainhar

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
translations.en.transliteration: Inna shaniaka huwa alabtaru

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "O disbelievers,
translations.en.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroona

verses.arabic: لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.en.sahih: I do not worship what you worship.
translations.en.transliteration: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

translations.en.sahih: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

verses.arabic: وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

translations.en.sahih: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
translations.en.transliteration: Wal<u>a</u> an<u>a</u> AA<u>a</u>bidun m<u>a</u> AAabadtum

verses.arabic: وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ

translations.en.sahih: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
translations.en.transliteration: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

verses.arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ

translations.en.sahih: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
translations.en.transliteration: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni

verses.arabic: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ

translations.en.sahih: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
translations.en.transliteration: Itha jaa nasru Allahi waalfathu

verses.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

translations.en.sahih: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
translations.en.transliteration: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

verses.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا

translations.en.sahih: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
translations.en.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

verses.arabic: تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ

translations.en.sahih: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
translations.en.transliteration: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba

verses.arabic: مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُ وَمَا كَسَبَ

translations.en.sahih: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
translations.en.transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

verses.arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ

translations.en.sahih: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
translations.en.transliteration: Sayasla naran thata lahabin

verses.arabic: وَامْرَأَتُهُ حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ

translations.en.sahih: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
translations.en.transliteration: Waimraatuhu hammalata alhatabi

verses.arabic: فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍ

translations.en.sahih: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
translations.en.transliteration: Fee jeediha hablun min masadin

verses.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,
translations.en.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun

verses.arabic: اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ

translations.en.sahih: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
translations.en.transliteration: Allahu alssamadu

verses.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

translations.en.sahih: He neither begets nor is born,
translations.en.transliteration: Lam yalid walam yooladu

verses.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

translations.en.sahih: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
translations.en.transliteration: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
translations.en.transliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alfalaqi

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

translations.en.sahih: From the evil of that which He created
translations.en.transliteration: Min sharri ma khalaqa

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

translations.en.sahih: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqaba

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ

translations.en.sahih: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin sharri alnnaffathati fee alAAuqadi

verses.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

translations.en.sahih: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
translations.en.transliteration: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
translations.en.transliteration: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alnnasi

verses.arabic: مَلِكِ النَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: The Sovereign of mankind.
translations.en.transliteration: Maliki alnnasi

verses.arabic: إِلَـٰهِ النَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: The God of mankind,
translations.en.transliteration: Ilahi alnnasi

verses.arabic: مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
translations.en.transliteration: Min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi

verses.arabic: الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
translations.en.transliteration: Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoori alnnasi

verses.arabic: مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

translations.en.sahih: From among the jinn and mankind."
translations.en.transliteration: Mina aljinnati wa alnnasm
